texetai de huion kai kaleseis to onoma autou iesoun autos gar sosei ton laon autou apo ton hamartion auton

idou he parthenos en gastri hexei kai texetai huion kai kalesousin to onoma autou emmanouel ho estin methermeneuomenon meth hemon ho theos

tou de iesou gennethentos en bethleem tes ioudaias en hemerais herodou tou basileos idou magoi apo anatolon paregenonto eis hierosoluma
legontes pou estin ho techtheis basileus ton ioudaion eidomen gar autou ton astera en te anatole kai elthomen proskunesai auto
akousas de herodes ho basileus etarachthe kai pasa hierosoluma met autou
kai sunagagon pantas tous archiereis kai grammateis tou laou epunthaneto par auton pou ho christos gennatai
hoi de eipon auto en bethleem tes ioudaias houtos gar gegraptai dia tou prophetou
kai su bethleem ge iouda oudamos elachiste ei en tois hegemosin iouda ek sou gar exeleusetai hegoumenos hostis poimanei ton laon mou ton israel
tote herodes lathra kalesas tous magous ekribosen par auton ton chronon tou phainomenou asteros
kai pempsas autous eis bethleem eipen poreuthentes akribos exetasate peri tou paidiou epan de heurete apaneilate moi hopos kago elthon proskuneso auto

kai chrematisthentes kat onar me anakampsai pros heroden di alles hodou anechoresan eis ten choran auton

akousas de hoti archelaos basileuei epi tes ioudaias anti herodou tou patros autou ephobethe ekei apelthein chrematistheis de kat onar anechoresen eis ta mere tes galilaias

en de tais hemerais ekeinais paraginetai ioannes ho baptistes kerusson en te eremo tes ioudaias

houtos gar estin ho hretheis hupo esaiou tou prophetou legontos phone boontos en te eremo hetoimasate ten hodon kuriou eutheias poieite tas tribous autou
autos de ho ioannes eichen to enduma autou apo trichon kamelou kai zonen dermatinen peri ten osphun autou he de trophe autou en akrides kai meli agrion
tote exeporeueto pros auton hierosoluma kai pasa he ioudaia kai pasa he perichoros tou iordanou
kai ebaptizonto en to iordane hup autou exomologoumenoi tas hamartias auton
idon de pollous ton pharisaion kai saddoukaion erchomenous epi to baptisma autou eipen autois gennemata echidnon tis hupedeixen humin phugein apo tes mellouses orges
poiesate oun karpous axious tes metanoias
kai me doxete legein en heautois patera echomen ton abraam lego gar humin hoti dunatai ho theos ek ton lithon touton egeirai tekna to abraam
ede de kai he axine pros ten hrizan ton dendron keitai pan oun dendron me poioun karpon kalon ekkoptetai kai eis pur balletai
ego men baptizo humas en hudati eis metanoian ho de opiso mou erchomenos ischuroteros mou estin hou ouk eimi hikanos ta hupodemata bastasai autos humas baptisei en pneumati hagio kai puri
hou to ptuon en te cheiri autou kai diakathariei ten halona autou kai sunaxei ton siton autou eis ten apotheken to de achuron katakausei puri asbesto
tote paraginetai ho iesous apo tes galilaias epi ton iordanen pros ton ioannen tou baptisthenai hup autou
ho de ioannes diekoluen auton legon ego chreian echo hupo sou baptisthenai kai su erche pros me
apokritheis de ho iesous eipen pros auton aphes arti houtos gar prepon estin hemin plerosai pasan dikaiosunen tote aphiesin auton
kai baptistheis ho iesous anebe euthus apo tou hudatos kai idou aneochthesan auto hoi ouranoi kai eiden to pneuma tou theou katabainon hosei peristeran kai erchomenon ep auton
kai idou phone ek ton ouranon legousa houtos estin ho huios mou ho agapetos en ho eudokesa
tote ho iesous anechthe eis ten eremon hupo tou pneumatos peirasthenai hupo tou diabolou
kai nesteusas hemeras tessarakonta kai nuktas tessarakonta husteron epeinasen
kai proselthon auto ho peirazon eipen ei huios ei tou theou eipe hina hoi lithoi houtoi artoi genontai
ho de apokritheis eipen gegraptai ouk ep arto mono zesetai anthropos all epi panti hremati ekporeuomeno dia stomatos theou
tote paralambanei auton ho diabolos eis ten hagian polin kai histesin auton epi to pterugion tou hierou
kai legei auto ei huios ei tou theou bale seauton kato gegraptai gar hoti tois anelois autou enteleitai peri sou kai epi cheiron arousin se mepote proskopses pros lithon ton poda sou

kai ouk epoiesen ekei dunameis pollas dia ten apistian auton
en ekeino to kairo ekousen herodes ho tetrarches ten akoen iesou
kai eipen tois paisin autou houtos estin ioannes ho baptistes autos egerthe apo ton nekron kai dia touto hai dunameis energousin en auto

elegen gar auto ho ioannes ouk exestin soi echein auten

genesion de agomenon tou herodou orchesato he thugater tes herodiados en to meso kai eresen to herode
hothen meth horkou homologesen aute dounai ho ean aitesetai

en ekeine te hora proselthon hoi mathetai to iesou legontes tis ara meizon estin en te basileia ton ouranon
kai proskalesamenos ho iesous paidion estesen auto en meso auton
kai eipen amen lego humin ean me straphete kai genesthe hos ta paidia ou me eiselthete eis ten basileian ton ouranon
hostis oun tapeinose heauton hos to paidion touto houtos estin ho meizon en te basileia ton ouranon
kai hos ean dexetai paidion toiouton hen epi to onomati mou eme dechetai
hos d an skandalise hena ton mikron touton ton pisteuonton eis eme sumpherei auto hina kremasthe mulos onikos epi ton trachelon autou kai katapontisthe en to pelagei tes thalasses
ouai to kosmo apo ton skandalon ananke gar estin elthein ta skandala plen ouai to anthropo ekeino di hou to skandalon erchetai

ei de he cheir sou e ho pous sou skandalizei se ekkopson auta kai bale apo sou kalon soi estin eiselthein eis ten zoen cholon e kullon e duo cheiras e duo podas echonta blethenai eis to pur to aionion
kai ei ho ophthalmos sou skandalizei se exele auton kai bale apo sou kalon soi estin monophthalmon eis ten zoen eiselthein e duo ophthalmous echonta blethenai eis ten geennan tou puros
horate me kataphronesete henos ton mikron touton lego gar humin hoti hoi aneloi auton en ouranois dia pantos blepousin to prosopon tou patros mou tou en ouranois
elthen gar ho huios tou anthropou sosai to apololos
ti humin dokei ean genetai tini anthropo hekaton probata kai planethe hen ex auton ouchi apheis ta ennenekontaennea epi ta ore poreutheis zetei to planomenon
kai ean genetai heurein auto amen lego humin hoti chairei ep auto mallon e epi tois ennenekontaennea tois me peplanemenois
houtos ouk estin thelema emprosthen tou patros humon tou en ouranois hina apoletai heis ton mikron touton
ean de hamartese eis se ho adelphos sou hupage kai elegxon auton metaxu sou kai autou monou ean sou akouse ekerdesas ton adelphon sou
ean de me akouse paralabe meta sou eti hena e duo hina epi stomatos duo marturon e trion stathe pan hrema
ean de parakouse auton eipe te ekklesia ean de kai tes ekklesias parakouse esto soi hosper ho ethnikos kai ho telones
amen lego humin hosa ean desete epi tes ges estai dedemena en to ourano kai hosa ean lusete epi tes ges estai lelumena en to ourano
palin lego humin hoti ean duo humon sumphonesosin epi tes ges peri pantos pragmatos hou ean aitesontai genesetai autois para tou patros mou tou en ouranois
hou gar eisin duo e treis sunegmenoi eis to emon onoma ekei eimi en meso auton
tote proselthon auto ho petros eipen kurie posakis hamartesei eis eme ho adelphos mou kai apheso auto heos heptakis
legei auto ho iesous ou lego soi heos heptakis all heos hebdomekontakis hepta
dia touto homoiothe he basileia ton ouranon anthropo basilei hos ethelesen sunarai logon meta ton doulon autou
arxamenou de autou sunairein prosenechthe auto heis opheiletes murion talanton
me echontos de autou apodounai ekeleusen auton ho kurios autou prathenai kai ten gunaika autou kai ta tekna kai panta hosa eichen kai apodothenai
peson oun ho doulos prosekunei auto legon kurie makrothumeson ep emoi kai panta soi apodoso
splanchnistheis de ho kurios tou doulou ekeinou apelusen auton kai to daneion apheken auto
exelthon de ho doulos ekeinos heuren hena ton sundoulon autou hos opheilen auto hekaton denaria kai kratesas auton epnigen legon apodos moi ho ti opheileis
peson oun ho sundoulos autou eis tous podas autou parekalei auton legon makrothumeson ep emoi kai panta apodoso soi
ho de ouk ethelen alla apelthon ebalen auton eis phulaken heos hou apodo to opheilomenon
idontes de hoi sundouloi autou ta genomena elupethesan sphodra kai elthontes diesaphesan to kurio auton panta ta genomena
tote proskalesamenos auton ho kurios autou legei auto doule ponere pasan ten opheilen ekeinen apheka soi epei parekalesas me
ouk edei kai se eleesai ton sundoulon sou hos kai ego se eleesa
kai orgistheis ho kurios autou paredoken auton tois basanistais heos hou apodo pan to opheilomenon auto
houtos kai ho pater mou ho epouranios poiesei humin ean me aphete hekastos to adelpho autou apo ton kardion humon ta paraptomata auton
kai egeneto hote etelesen ho iesous tous logous toutous meteren apo tes galilaias kai elthen eis ta horia tes ioudaias peran tou iordanou
kai ekolouthesan auto ochloi polloi kai etherapeusen autous ekei
kai proselthon auto hoi pharisaioi peirazontes auton kai legontes auto ei exestin anthropo apolusai ten gunaika autou kata pasan aitian
ho de apokritheis eipen autois ouk anegnote hoti ho poiesas ap arches arsen kai thelu epoiesen autous
kai eipen heneken toutou kataleipsei anthropos ton patera kai ten metera kai proskollethesetai te gunaiki autou kai esontai hoi duo eis sarka mian
hoste ouketi eisin duo alla sarx mia ho oun ho theos sunezeuxen anthropos me chorizeto

ho de eipen autois ou pantes chorousin ton logon touton all hois dedotai

tote apokritheis ho petros eipen auto idou hemeis aphekamen panta kai ekolouthesamen soi ti ara estai hemin

kai pas hos apheken oikias e adelphous e adelphas e patera e metera e gunaika e tekna e agrous heneken tou onomatos mou hekatontaplasiona lepsetai kai zoen aionion kleronomesei

kai erxato didaskein autous hoti dei ton huion tou anthropou polla pathein kai apodokimasthenai apo ton presbuteron kai archiereon kai grammateon kai apoktanthenai kai meta treis hemeras anastenai
kai parresia ton logon elalei kai proslabomenos auton ho petros erxato epitiman auto
ho de epistrapheis kai idon tous mathetas autou epetimesen to petro legon hupage opiso mou satana hoti ou phroneis ta tou theou alla ta ton anthropon
kai proskalesamenos ton ochlon sun tois mathetais autou eipen autois hostis thelei opiso mou elthein aparnesastho heauton kai arato ton stauron autou kai akoloutheito moi
hos gar an thele ten psuchen autou sosai apolesei auten hos d an apolese ten psuchen autou heneken emou kai tou euaneliou houtos sosei auten
ti gar ophelesei anthropon ean kerdese ton kosmon holon kai zemiothe ten psuchen autou
e ti dosei anthropos antallagma tes psuches autou

hos gar an epaischunthe me kai tous emous logous en te genea taute te moichalidi kai hamartolo kai ho huios tou anthropou epaischunthesetai auton hotan elthe en te doxe tou patros autou meta ton anelon ton hagion
kai elegen autois amen lego humin hoti eisin tines ton hode hestekoton hoitines ou me geusontai thanatou heos an idosin ten basileian tou theou eleluthuian en dunamei
kai meth hemeras hex paralambanei ho iesous ton petron kai ton iakobon kai ton ioannen kai anapherei autous eis oros hupselon kat idian monous kai metemorphothe emprosthen auton
kai ta himatia autou egeneto stilbonta leuka lian hos chion hoia gnapheus epi tes ges ou dunatai leukanai
kai ophthe autois elias sun mosei kai esan sullalountes to iesou
kai apokritheis ho petros legei to iesou hrabbi kalon estin hemas hode einai kai poiesomen skenas treis soi mian kai mosei mian kai elia mian
ou gar edei ti lalese esan gar ekphoboi
kai egeneto nephele episkiazousa autois kai elthen phone ek tes nepheles legousa houtos estin ho huios mou ho agapetos autou akouete
kai exapina periblepsamenoi ouketi oudena eidon alla ton iesoun monon meth heauton
katabainonton de auton apo tou orous diesteilato autois hina medeni diegesontai ha eidon ei me hotan ho huios tou anthropou ek nekron anaste
kai ton logon ekratesan pros heautous suzetountes ti estin to ek nekron anastenai
kai eperoton auton legontes hoti legousin hoi grammateis hoti elian dei elthein proton
ho de apokritheis eipen autois elias men elthon proton apokathista panta kai pos gegraptai epi ton huion tou anthropou hina polla pathe kai exoudenothe
alla lego humin hoti kai elias eleluthen kai epoiesan auto hosa ethelesan kathos gegraptai ep auton
kai elthon pros tous mathetas eiden ochlon polun peri autous kai grammateis suzetountas autois
kai eutheos pas ho ochlos idon auton exethambethe kai prostrechontes espazonto auton
kai eperotesen tous grammateis ti suzeteite pros hautous
kai apokritheis heis ek tou ochlou eipen didaskale enenka ton huion mou pros se echonta pneuma alalon
kai hopou an auton katalabe hressei auton kai aphrizei kai trizei tous odontas autou kai xerainetai kai eipon tois mathetais sou hina auto ekbalosin kai ouk ischusan
ho de apokritheis auto legei o genea apistos heos pote pros humas esomai heos pote anexomai humon pherete auton pros me
kai enenkan auton pros auton kai idon auton eutheos to pneuma esparaxen auton kai peson epi tes ges ekulieto aphrizon
kai eperotesen ton patera autou posos chronos estin hos touto gegonen auto ho de eipen paidiothen
kai pollakis auton kai eis pur ebalen kai eis hudata hina apolese auton all ei ti dunasai boetheson hemin splanchnistheis eph hemas
ho de iesous eipen auto to ei dunasai pisteusai panta dunata to pisteuonti
kai eutheos kraxas ho pater tou paidiou meta dakruon elegen pisteuo kurie boethei mou te apistia
idon de ho iesous hoti episuntrechei ochlos epetimesen to pneumati to akatharto legon auto to pneuma to alalon kai kophon ego soi epitasso exelthe ex autou kai meketi eiselthes eis auton
kai kraxan kai polla sparaxan auton exelthen kai egeneto hosei nekros hoste pollous legein hoti apethanen
ho de iesous kratesas auton tes cheiros egeiren auton kai aneste
kai eiselthonta auton eis oikon hoi mathetai autou eperoton auton kat idian hoti hemeis ouk edunethemen ekbalein auto
kai eipen autois touto to genos en oudeni dunatai exelthein ei me en proseuche kai nesteia
kai ekeithen exelthontes pareporeuonto dia tes galilaias kai ouk ethelen hina tis gno
edidasken gar tous mathetas autou kai elegen autois hoti ho huios tou anthropou paradidotai eis cheiras anthropon kai apoktenousin auton kai apoktantheis te trite hemera anastesetai
hoi de egnooun to hrema kai ephobounto auton eperotesai
kai elthen eis kapernaoum kai en te oikia genomenos eperota autous ti en te hodo pros heautous dielogizesthe
hoi de esiopon pros allelous gar dielechthesan en te hodo tis meizon
kai kathisas ephonesen tous dodeka kai legei autois ei tis thelei protos einai estai panton eschatos kai panton diakonos
kai labon paidion estesen auto en meso auton kai enankalisamenos auto eipen autois
hos ean hen ton toiouton paidion dexetai epi to onomati mou eme dechetai kai hos ean eme dexetai ouk eme dechetai alla ton aposteilanta me
apekrithe de auto ho ioannes legon didaskale eidomen tina to onomati sou ekballonta daimonia hos ouk akolouthei hemin kai ekolusamen auton hoti ouk akolouthei hemin
ho de iesous eipen me koluete auton oudeis gar estin hos poiesei dunamin epi to onomati mou kai dunesetai tachu kakologesai me
hos gar ouk estin kath humon huper humon estin
hos gar an potise humas poterion hudatos en to onomati mou hoti christou este amen lego humin ou me apolese ton misthon autou
kai hos an skandalise hena ton mikron ton pisteuonton eis eme kalon estin auto mallon ei perikeitai lithos mulikos peri ton trachelon autou kai bebletai eis ten thalassan
kai ean skandalize se he cheir sou apokopson auten kalon soi estin kullon eis ten zoen eiselthein e tas duo cheiras echonta apelthein eis ten geennan eis to pur to asbeston
hopou ho skolex auton ou teleuta kai to pur ou sbennutai
kai ean ho pous sou skandalize se apokopson auton kalon estin soi eiselthein eis ten zoen cholon e tous duo podas echonta blethenai eis ten geennan eis to pur to asbeston
hopou ho skolex auton ou teleuta kai to pur ou sbennutai
kai ean ho ophthalmos sou skandalize se ekbale auton kalon soi estin monophthalmon eiselthein eis ten basileian tou theou e duo ophthalmous echonta blethenai eis ten geennan tou puros
hopou ho skolex auton ou teleuta kai to pur ou sbennutai
pas gar puri halisthesetai kai pasa thusia hali halisthesetai
kalon to halas ean de to halas analon genetai en tini auto artusete echete en heautois halas kai eireneuete en allelois
kakeithen anastas erchetai eis ta horia tes ioudaias dia tou peran tou iordanou kai sumporeuontai palin ochloi pros auton kai hos eiothei palin edidasken autous
kai proselthontes hoi pharisaioi eperotesan auton ei exestin andri gunaika apolusai peirazontes auton
ho de apokritheis eipen autois ti humin eneteilato moses
hoi de eipon moses epetrepsen biblion apostasiou grapsai kai apolusai
kai apokritheis ho iesous eipen autois pros ten sklerokardian humon egrapsen humin ten entolen tauten
apo de arches ktiseos arsen kai thelu epoiesen autous ho theos
heneken toutou kataleipsei anthropos ton patera autou kai ten metera kai proskollethesetai pros ten gunaika autou
kai esontai hoi duo eis sarka mian hoste ouketi eisin duo alla mia sarx
ho oun ho theos sunezeuxen anthropos me chorizeto
kai en te oikia palin hoi mathetai autou peri tou autou eperotesan auton
kai legei autois hos ean apoluse ten gunaika autou kai gamese allen moichatai ep auten
kai ean gune apoluse ton andra autes kai gamethe allo moichatai
kai prosepheron auto paidia hina hapsetai auton hoi de mathetai epetimon tois prospherousin
idon de ho iesous eganaktesen kai eipen autois aphete ta paidia erchesthai pros me kai me koluete auta ton gar toiouton estin he basileia tou theou
amen lego humin hos ean me dexetai ten basileian tou theou hos paidion ou me eiselthe eis auten
kai enankalisamenos auta titheis tas cheiras ep auta eulogei auta
kai ekporeuomenou autou eis hodon prosdramon heis kai gonupetesas auton eperota auton didaskale agathe ti poieso hina zoen aionion kleronomeso
ho de iesous eipen auto ti me legeis agathon oudeis agathos ei me heis ho theos
tas entolas oidas me moicheuses me phoneuses me klepses me pseudomartureses me apostereses tima ton patera sou kai ten metera
ho de apokritheis eipen auto didaskale tauta panta ephulaxamen ek neotetos mou
ho de iesous emblepsas auto egapesen auton kai eipen auto hen soi husterei hupage hosa echeis poleson kai dos tois ptochois kai hexeis thesauron en ourano kai deuro akolouthei moi aras ton stauron
ho de stugnasas epi to logo apelthen lupoumenos en gar echon ktemata polla
kai periblepsamenos ho iesous legei tois mathetais autou pos duskolos hoi ta chremata echontes eis ten basileian tou theou eiseleusontai
hoi de mathetai ethambounto epi tois logois autou ho de iesous palin apokritheis legei autois tekna pos duskolon estin tous pepoithotas epi tois chremasin eis ten basileian tou theou eiselthein
eukopoteron estin kamelon dia tes trumalias tes hraphidos eiselthein e plousion eis ten basileian tou theou eiselthein
hoi de perissos exeplessonto legontes pros heautous kai tis dunatai sothenai
emblepsas de autois ho iesous legei para anthropois adunaton all ou para to theo panta gar dunata estin para to theo
kai erxato ho petros legein auto idou hemeis aphekamen panta kai ekolouthesamen soi
apokritheis de ho iesous eipen amen lego humin oudeis estin hos apheken oikian e adelphous e adelphas e patera e metera e gunaika e tekna e agrous heneken emou kai tou euaneliou
ean me labe hekatontaplasiona nun en to kairo touto oikias kai adelphous kai adelphas kai meteras kai tekna kai agrous meta diogmon kai en to aioni to erchomeno zoen aionion
polloi de esontai protoi eschatoi kai hoi eschatoi protoi

esan de en te hodo anabainontes eis hierosoluma kai en proagon autous ho iesous kai ethambounto kai akolouthountes ephobounto kai paralabon palin tous dodeka erxato autois legein ta mellonta auto sumbainein
hoti idou anabainomen eis hierosoluma kai ho huios tou anthropou paradothesetai tois archiereusin kai tois grammateusin kai katakrinousin auton thanato kai paradosousin auton tois ethnesin
kai empaixousin auto kai mastigosousin auton kai emptusousin auto kai apoktenousin auton kai te trite hemera anastesetai
kai prosporeuontai auto iakobos kai ioannes hoi huioi zebedaiou legontes didaskale thelomen hina ho ean aitesomen poieses hemin
ho de eipen autois ti thelete poiesai me humin
hoi de eipon auto dos hemin hina heis ek dexion sou kai heis ex euonumon sou kathisomen en te doxe sou
ho de iesous eipen autois ouk oidate ti aiteisthe dunasthe piein to poterion ho ego pino kai to baptisma ho ego baptizomai baptisthenai
hoi de eipon auto dunametha ho de iesous eipen autois to men poterion ho ego pino piesthe kai to baptisma ho ego baptizomai baptisthesesthe
to de kathisai ek dexion mou kai ex euonumon mou ouk estin emon dounai all hois hetoimastai
kai akousantes hoi deka erxanto aganaktein peri iakobou kai ioannou
ho de iesous proskalesamenos autous legei autois oidate hoti hoi dokountes archein ton ethnon katakurieuousin auton kai hoi megaloi auton katexousiazousin auton
ouch houtos de estai en humin all hos ean thele genesthai megas en humin estai diakonos humon
kai hos an thele humon genesthai protos estai panton doulos
kai gar ho huios tou anthropou ouk elthen diakonethenai alla diakonesai kai dounai ten psuchen autou lutron anti pollon
kai erchontai eis iericho kai ekporeuomenou autou apo iericho kai ton matheton autou kai ochlou hikanou huios timaiou bartimaios ho tuphlos ekatheto para ten hodon prosaiton
kai akousas hoti iesous ho nazoraios estin erxato krazein kai legein ho huios dabid iesou eleeson me
kai epetimon auto polloi hina siopese ho de pollo mallon ekrazen huie dabid eleeson me
kai stas ho iesous eipen auton phonethenai kai phonousin ton tuphlon legontes auto tharsei egeirai phonei se
ho de apobalon to himation autou anastas elthen pros ton iesoun
kai apokritheis legei auto ho iesous ti theleis poieso soi ho de tuphlos eipen auto hrabboni hina anablepso
ho de iesous eipen auto hupage he pistis sou sesoken se kai eutheos aneblepsen kai ekolouthei to iesou en te hodo
kai hote enizousin eis ierousalem eis bethphage kai bethanian pros to oros ton elaion apostellei duo ton matheton autou
kai legei autois hupagete eis ten komen ten katenanti humon kai eutheos eisporeuomenoi eis auten heuresete polon dedemenon eph hon oudeis anthropon kekathiken lusantes auton agagete
kai ean tis humin eipe ti poieite touto eipate hoti ho kurios autou chreian echei kai eutheos auton apostelei hode
apelthon de kai heuron ton polon dedemenon pros ten thuran exo epi tou amphodou kai luousin auton
kai tines ton ekei hestekoton elegon autois ti poieite luontes ton polon
hoi de eipon autois kathos eneteilato ho iesous kai aphekan autous
kai egagon ton polon pros ton iesoun kai epebalon auto ta himatia auton kai ekathisen ep auto
polloi de ta himatia auton estrosan eis ten hodon alloi de stoibadas ekopton ek ton dendron kai estronnuon eis ten hodon
kai hoi proagontes kai hoi akolouthountes ekrazon legontes hosanna eulogemenos ho erchomenos en onomati kuriou
eulogemene he erchomene basileia en onomati kuriou tou patros hemon dabid hosanna en tois hupsistois
kai eiselthen eis hierosoluma ho iesous kai eis to hieron kai periblepsamenos panta opsias ede ouses tes horas exelthen eis bethanian meta ton dodeka
kai te epaurion exelthonton auton apo bethanias epeinasen
kai idon suken makrothen echousan phulla elthen ei ara heuresei ti en aute kai elthon ep auten ouden heuren ei me phulla ou gar en kairos sukon
kai apokritheis ho iesous eipen aute meketi ek sou eis ton aiona medeis karpon phagoi kai ekouon hoi mathetai autou

kai erchontai eis hierosoluma kai eiselthon ho iesous eis to hieron erxato ekballein tous polountas kai agorazontas en to hiero kai tas trapezas ton kollubiston kai tas kathedras ton polounton tas peristeras katestrepsen
kai ouk ephien hina tis dienenke skeuos dia tou hierou
kai edidasken legon autois ou gegraptai hoti ho oikos mou oikos proseuches klethesetai pasin tois ethnesin humeis de epoiesate auton spelaion leston
kai ekousan hoi grammateis kai hoi archiereis kai ezetoun pos auton apolesousin ephobounto gar auton hoti pas ho ochlos exeplesseto epi te didache autou
kai hote opse egeneto exeporeueto exo tes poleos
kai proi paraporeuomenoi eidon ten suken exerammenen ek hrizon
kai anamnestheis ho petros legei auto hrabbi ide he suke hen kateraso exerantai
kai apokritheis iesous legei autois echete pistin theou
amen gar lego humin hoti hos an eipe to orei touto artheti kai bletheti eis ten thalassan kai me diakrithe en te kardia autou alla pisteuse hoti ha legei ginetai estai auto ho ean eipe
dia touto lego humin panta hosa an proseuchomenoi aiteisthe pisteuete hoti lambanete kai estai humin
kai hotan stekete proseuchomenoi aphiete ei ti echete kata tinos hina kai ho pater humon ho en tois ouranois aphe humin ta paraptomata humon
ei de humeis ouk aphiete oude ho pater humon ho en tois ouranois aphesei ta paraptomata humon
kai erchontai palin eis hierosoluma kai en to hiero peripatountos autou erchontai pros auton hoi archiereis kai hoi grammateis kai hoi presbuteroi
kai legousin auto en poia exousia tauta poieis kai tis soi ten exousian tauten edoken hina tauta poies
ho de iesous apokritheis eipen autois eperoteso humas kago hena logon kai apokrithete moi kai ero humin en poia exousia tauta poio
to baptisma ioannou ex ouranou en e ex anthropon apokrithete moi
kai elogizonto pros heautous legontes ean eipomen ex ouranou erei dia ti oun ouk episteusate auto
all ean eipomen ex anthropon ephobounto ton laon hapantes gar eichon ton ioannen hoti ontos prophetes en
kai apokrithentes legousin to iesou ouk oidamen kai ho iesous apokritheis legei autois oude ego lego humin en poia exousia tauta poio
kai erxato autois en parabolais legein ampelona ephuteusen anthropos kai perietheken phragmon kai oruxen hupolenion kai okodomesen purgon kai exedoto auton georgois kai apedemesen
kai apesteilen pros tous georgous to kairo doulon hina para ton georgon labe apo tou karpou tou ampelonos
hoi de labontes auton edeiran kai apesteilan kenon
kai palin apesteilen pros autous allon doulon kakeinon lithobolesantes ekephalaiosan kai apesteilan etimomenon
kai palin allon apesteilen kakeinon apekteinan kai pollous allous tous men derontes tous de apokteinontes
eti oun hena huion echon agapeton autou apesteilen kai auton pros autous eschaton legon hoti entrapesontai ton huion mou
ekeinoi de hoi georgoi eipon pros heautous hoti houtos estin ho kleronomos deute apokteinomen auton kai hemon estai he kleronomia
kai labontes auton apekteinan kai exebalon exo tou ampelonos
ti oun poiesei ho kurios tou ampelonos eleusetai kai apolesei tous georgous kai dosei ton ampelona allois
oude ten graphen tauten anegnote lithon hon apedokimasan hoi oikodomountes houtos egenethe eis kephalen gonias
para kuriou egeneto haute kai estin thaumaste en ophthalmois hemon
kai ezetoun auton kratesai kai ephobethesan ton ochlon egnosan gar hoti pros autous ten parabolen eipen kai aphentes auton apelthon
kai apostellousin pros auton tinas ton pharisaion kai ton herodianon hina auton agreusosin logo

hoi de elthontes legousin auto didaskale oidamen hoti alethes ei kai ou melei soi peri oudenos ou gar blepeis eis prosopon anthropon all ep aletheias ten hodon tou theou didaskeis exestin kenson kaisari dounai e ou
domen e me domen ho de eidos auton ten hupokrisin eipen autois ti me peirazete pherete moi denarion hina ido
hoi de enenkan kai legei autois tinos he eikon haute kai he epigraphe hoi de eipon auto kaisaros
kai apokritheis ho iesous eipen autois apodote ta kaisaros kaisari kai ta tou theou to theo kai ethaumasan ep auto
kai erchontai saddoukaioi pros auton hoitines legousin anastasin me einai kai eperotesan auton legontes
didaskale moses egrapsen hemin hoti ean tinos adelphos apothane kai katalipe gunaika kai tekna me aphe hina labe ho adelphos autou ten gunaika autou kai exanastese sperma to adelpho autou
hepta adelphoi esan kai ho protos elaben gunaika kai apothneskon ouk apheken sperma
kai ho deuteros elaben auten kai apethanen kai oude autos apheken sperma kai ho tritos hosautos
kai elabon auten hoi hepta kai ouk aphekan sperma eschate panton apethanen kai he gune
en te oun anastasei hotan anastosin tinos auton estai gune hoi gar hepta eschon auten gunaika
kai apokritheis ho iesous eipen autois ou dia touto planasthe me eidotes tas graphas mede ten dunamin tou theou
hotan gar ek nekron anastosin oute gamousin oute gamiskontai all eisin hos aneloi hoi en tois ouranois
peri de ton nekron hoti egeirontai ouk anegnote en te biblo moseos epi tes batou hos eipen auto ho theos legon ego ho theos abraam kai ho theos isaak kai ho theos iakob
ouk estin ho theos nekron alla theos zonton humeis oun polu planasthe
kai proselthon heis ton grammateon akousas auton suzetounton eidos hoti kalos autois apekrithe eperotesen auton poia estin prote pason entole
ho de iesous apekrithe auto hoti prote pason ton entolon akoue israel kurios ho theos hemon kurios heis estin
kai agapeseis kurion ton theon sou ex holes tes kardias sou kai ex holes tes psuches sou kai ex holes tes dianoias sou kai ex holes tes ischuos sou haute prote entole
kai deutera homoia haute agapeseis ton plesion sou hos seauton meizon touton alle entole ouk estin
kai eipen auto ho grammateus kalos didaskale ep aletheias eipas hoti heis estin theos kai ouk estin allos plen autou

kai to agapan auton ex holes tes kardias kai ex holes tes suneseos kai ex holes tes psuches kai ex holes tes ischuos kai to agapan ton plesion hos heauton pleion estin panton ton holokautomaton kai ton thusion
kai ho iesous idon auton hoti nounechos apekrithe eipen auto ou makran ei apo tes basileias tou theou kai oudeis ouketi etolma auton eperotesai
kai apokritheis ho iesous elegen didaskon en to hiero pos legousin hoi grammateis hoti ho christos huios estin dabid
autos gar dabid eipen en to pneumati to hagio eipen ho kurios to kurio mou kathou ek dexion mou heos an tho tous echthrous sou hupopodion ton podon sou
autos oun dabid legei auton kurion kai pothen huios autou estin kai ho polus ochlos ekouen autou hedeos
kai elegen autois en te didache autou blepete apo ton grammateon ton thelonton en stolais peripatein kai aspasmous en tais agorais
kai protokathedrias en tais sunagogais kai protoklisias en tois deipnois
hoi katesthiontes tas oikias ton cheron kai prophasei makra proseuchomenoi houtoi lepsontai perissoteron krima
kai kathisas ho iesous katenanti tou gazophulakiou etheorei pos ho ochlos ballei chalkon eis to gazophulakion kai polloi plousioi eballon polla
kai elthousa mia chera ptoche ebalen lepta duo ho estin kodrantes
kai proskalesamenos tous mathetas autou legei autois amen lego humin hoti he chera haute he ptoche pleion panton bebleken ton balonton eis to gazophulakion
pantes gar ek tou perisseuontos autois ebalon haute de ek tes hustereseos autes panta hosa eichen ebalen holon ton bion autes
kai ekporeuomenou autou ek tou hierou legei auto heis ton matheton autou didaskale ide potapoi lithoi kai potapai oikodomai
kai ho iesous apokritheis eipen auto blepeis tautas tas megalas oikodomas ou me aphethe lithos epi litho hos ou me kataluthe
kai kathemenou autou eis to oros ton elaion katenanti tou hierou eperoton auton kat idian petros kai iakobos kai ioannes kai andreas

kai basileusei epi ton oikon iakob eis tous aionas kai tes basileias autou ouk estai telos
eipen de mariam pros ton anelon pos estai touto epei andra ou ginosko
kai apokritheis ho anelos eipen aute pneuma hagion epeleusetai epi se kai dunamis hupsistou episkiasei soi dio kai to gennomenon hagion klethesetai huios theou
kai idou elisabet he sunenes sou kai aute suneilephuia huion en gera autes kai houtos men hektos estin aute te kaloumene steira
hoti ouk adunatesei para to theo pan hrema
eipen de mariam idou he doule kuriou genoito moi kata to hrema sou kai apelthen ap autes ho anelos
anastasa de mariam en tais hemerais tautais eporeuthe eis ten oreinen meta spoudes eis polin iouda
kai eiselthen eis ton oikon zachariou kai espasato ten elisabet
kai egeneto hos ekousen he elisabet ton aspasmon tes marias eskirtesen to brephos en te koilia autes kai eplesthe pneumatos hagiou he elisabet
kai anephonesen phone megale kai eipen eulogemene su en gunaixin kai eulogemenos ho karpos tes koilias sou
kai pothen moi touto hina elthe he meter tou kuriou mou pros me
idou gar hos egeneto he phone tou aspasmou sou eis ta ota mou eskirtesen en agalliasei to brephos en te koilia mou
kai makaria he pisteusasa hoti estai teleiosis tois lelalemenois aute para kuriou
kai eipen mariam megalunei he psuche mou ton kurion
kai egalliasen to pneuma mou epi to theo to soteri mou
hoti epeblepsen epi ten tapeinosin tes doules autou idou gar apo tou nun makariousin me pasai hai geneai
hoti epoiesen moi megaleia ho dunatos kai hagion to onoma autou
kai to eleos autou eis geneas geneon tois phoboumenois auton
epoiesen kratos en brachioni autou dieskorpisen huperephanous dianoia kardias auton
katheilen dunastas apo thronon kai hupsosen tapeinous
peinontas eneplesen agathon kai ploutountas exapesteilen kenous
antelabeto israel paidos autou mnesthenai eleous
kathos elalesen pros tous pateras hemon to abraam kai to spermati autou eis ton aiona
emeinen de mariam sun aute hosei menas treis kai hupestrepsen eis ton oikon autes
te de elisabet eplesthe ho chronos tou tekein auten kai egennesen huion
kai ekousan hoi perioikoi kai hoi suneneis autes hoti emegalunen kurios to eleos autou met autes kai sunechairon aute
kai egeneto en te ogdoe hemera elthon peritemein to paidion kai ekaloun auto epi to onomati tou patros autou zacharian
kai apokritheisa he meter autou eipen ouchi alla klethesetai ioannes
kai eipon pros auten hoti oudeis estin en te suneneia sou hos kaleitai to onomati touto
eneneuon de to patri autou to ti an theloi kaleisthai auton
kai aitesas pinakidion egrapsen legon ioannes estin to onoma autou kai ethaumasan pantes
aneochthe de to stoma autou parachrema kai he glossa autou kai elalei eulogon ton theon
kai egeneto epi pantas phobos tous perioikountas autous kai en hole te oreine tes ioudaias dielaleito panta ta hremata tauta
kai ethento pantes hoi akousantes en te kardia auton legontes ti ara to paidion touto estai kai cheir kuriou en met autou
kai zacharias ho pater autou eplesthe pneumatos hagiou kai proepheteusen legon
eulogetos kurios ho theos tou israel hoti epeskepsato kai epoiesen lutrosin to lao autou
kai egeiren keras soterias hemin en to oiko dabid tou paidos autou
kathos elalesen dia stomatos ton hagion ton ap aionos propheton autou
soterian ex echthron hemon kai ek cheiros panton ton misounton hemas
poiesai eleos meta ton pateron hemon kai mnesthenai diathekes hagias autou
horkon hon omosen pros abraam ton patera hemon
tou dounai hemin aphobos ek cheiros ton echthron hemon hrusthentas latreuein auto
en hosioteti kai dikaiosune enopion autou pasas tas hemeras tes zoes hemon
kai su paidion prophetes hupsistou klethese proporeuse gar pro prosopou kuriou hetoimasai hodous autou
tou dounai gnosin soterias to lao autou en aphesei hamartion auton
dia splanchna eleous theou hemon en hois epeskepsato hemas anatole ex hupsous
epiphanai tois en skotei kai skia thanatou kathemenois tou kateuthunai tous podas hemon eis hodon eirenes
to de paidion euxanen kai ekrataiouto pneumati kai en en tais eremois heos hemeras anadeixeos autou pros ton israel
egeneto de en tais hemerais ekeinais exelthen dogma para kaisaros augoustou apographesthai pasan ten oikoumenen
haute he apographe prote egeneto hegemoneuontos tes surias kureniou
kai eporeuonto pantes apographesthai hekastos eis ten idian polin
anebe de kai ioseph apo tes galilaias ek poleos nazaret eis ten ioudaian eis polin dabid hetis kaleitai bethleem dia to einai auton ex oikou kai patrias dabid
apograpsasthai sun mariam te memnesteumene auto gunaiki ouse enkuo
egeneto de en to einai autous ekei eplesthesan hai hemerai tou tekein auten
kai eteken ton huion autes ton prototokon kai esparganosen auton kai aneklinen auton en te phatne dioti ouk en autois topos en to katalumati
kai poimenes esan en te chora te aute agraulountes kai phulassontes phulakas tes nuktos epi ten poimnen auton
kai idou anelos kuriou epeste autois kai doxa kuriou perielampsen autous kai ephobethesan phobon megan
kai eipen autois ho anelos me phobeisthe idou gar euanelizomai humin charan megalen hetis estai panti to lao
hoti etechthe humin semeron soter hos estin christos kurios en polei dabid
kai touto humin to semeion heuresete brephos esparganomenon keimenon en te phatne
kai exaiphnes egeneto sun to anelo plethos stratias ouraniou ainounton ton theon kai legonton
doxa en hupsistois theo kai epi ges eirene en anthropois eudokia

kai egeneto hos apelthon ap auton eis ton ouranon hoi aneloi kai hoi anthropoi hoi poimenes eipon pros allelous dielthomen de heos bethleem kai idomen to hrema touto to gegonos ho ho kurios egnorisen hemin
kai elthon speusantes kai aneuron ten te mariam kai ton ioseph kai to brephos keimenon en te phatne
idontes de diegnorisan peri tou hrematos tou lalethentos autois peri tou paidiou toutou
kai pantes hoi akousantes ethaumasan peri ton lalethenton hupo ton poimenon pros autous
he de mariam panta suneterei ta hremata tauta sumballousa en te kardia autes
kai epestrepsan hoi poimenes doxazontes kai ainountes ton theon epi pasin hois ekousan kai eidon kathos elalethe pros autous
kai hote eplesthesan hemerai okto tou peritemein to paidion kai eklethe to onoma autou iesous to klethen hupo tou anelou pro tou sullephthenai auton en te koilia
kai hote eplesthesan hai hemerai tou katharismou auton kata ton nomon moseos anegagon auton eis hierosoluma parastesai to kurio
kathos gegraptai en nomo kuriou hoti pan arsen dianoigon metran hagion to kurio klethesetai
kai tou dounai thusian kata to eiremenon en nomo kuriou zeugos trugonon e duo neossous peristeron
kai idou en anthropos en ierousalem ho onoma sumeon kai ho anthropos houtos dikaios kai eulabes prosdechomenos paraklesin tou israel kai pneuma hagion en ep auton
kai en auto kechrematismenon hupo tou pneumatos tou hagiou me idein thanaton prin e ide ton christon kuriou
kai elthen en to pneumati eis to hieron kai en to eisagagein tous goneis to paidion iesoun tou poiesai autous kata to eithismenon tou nomou peri autou
kai autos edexato auto eis tas ankalas autou kai eulogesen ton theon kai eipen
nun apolueis ton doulon sou despota kata to hrema sou en eirene
hoti eidon hoi ophthalmoi mou to soterion sou
ho hetoimasas kata prosopon panton ton laon
phos eis apokalupsin ethnon kai doxan laou sou israel
kai en ioseph kai he meter autou thaumazontes epi tois laloumenois peri autou
kai eulogesen autous sumeon kai eipen pros mariam ten metera autou idou houtos keitai eis ptosin kai anastasin pollon en to israel kai eis semeion antilegomenon
kai sou de autes ten psuchen dieleusetai hromphaia hopos an apokaluphthosin ek pollon kardion dialogismoi
kai en hanna prophetis thugater phanouel ek phules aser haute probebekuia en hemerais pollais zesasa ete meta andros hepta apo tes parthenias autes
kai aute chera hos eton ogdoekontatessaron he ouk aphistato apo tou hierou nesteiais kai deesesin latreuousa nukta kai hemeran
kai aute aute te hora epistasa anthomologeito to kurio kai elalei peri autou pasin tois prosdechomenois lutrosin en ierousalem
kai hos etelesan hapanta ta kata ton nomon kuriou hupestrepsan eis ten galilaian eis ten polin auton nazaret
to de paidion euxanen kai ekrataiouto pneumati pleroumenon sophias kai charis theou en ep auto
kai eporeuonto hoi goneis autou kat etos eis ierousalem te heorte tou pascha
kai hote egeneto eton dodeka anabanton auton eis hierosoluma kata to ethos tes heortes
kai teleiosanton tas hemeras en to hupostrephein autous hupemeinen iesous ho pais en ierousalem kai ouk egno ioseph kai he meter autou
nomisantes de auton en te sunodia einai elthon hemeras hodon kai anezetoun auton en tois sunenesin kai en tois gnostois
kai me heurontes auton hupestrepsan eis ierousalem zetountes auton
kai egeneto meth hemeras treis heuron auton en to hiero kathezomenon en meso ton didaskalon kai akouonta auton kai eperotonta autous
existanto de pantes hoi akouontes autou epi te sunesei kai tais apokrisesin autou
kai idontes auton exeplagesan kai pros auton he meter autou eipen teknon ti epoiesas hemin houtos idou ho pater sou kago odunomenoi ezetoumen se
kai eipen pros autous ti hoti ezeteite me ouk edeite hoti en tois tou patros mou dei einai me
kai autoi ou sunekan to hrema ho elalesen autois
kai katebe met auton kai elthen eis nazaret kai en hupotassomenos autois kai he meter autou dieterei panta ta hremata tauta en te kardia autes
kai iesous proekopten sophia kai helikia kai chariti para theo kai anthropois

en etei de pentekaidekato tes hegemonias tiberiou kaisaros hegemoneuontos pontiou pilatou tes ioudaias kai tetrarchountos tes galilaias herodou philippou de tou adelphou autou tetrarchountos tes itouraias kai trachonitidos choras kai lusaniou tes abilenes tetrarchountos
ep archiereon hanna kai kaiapha egeneto hrema theou epi ioannen ton tou zachariou huion en te eremo
kai elthen eis pasan ten perichoron tou iordanou kerusson baptisma metanoias eis aphesin hamartion
hos gegraptai en biblo logon esaiou tou prophetou legontos phone boontos en te eremo hetoimasate ten hodon kuriou eutheias poieite tas tribous autou
pasa pharagx plerothesetai kai pan oros kai bounos tapeinothesetai kai estai ta skolia eis eutheian kai hai tracheiai eis hodous leias
kai opsetai pasa sarx to soterion tou theou
elegen oun tois ekporeuomenois ochlois baptisthenai hup autou gennemata echidnon tis hupedeixen humin phugein apo tes mellouses orges
poiesate oun karpous axious tes metanoias kai me arxesthe legein en heautois patera echomen ton abraam lego gar humin hoti dunatai ho theos ek ton lithon touton egeirai tekna to abraam
ede de kai he axine pros ten hrizan ton dendron keitai pan oun dendron me poioun karpon kalon ekkoptetai kai eis pur balletai
kai eperoton auton hoi ochloi legontes ti oun poiesomen
apokritheis de legei autois ho echon duo chitonas metadoto to me echonti kai ho echon bromata homoios poieito
elthon de kai telonai baptisthenai kai eipon pros auton didaskale ti poiesomen
ho de eipen pros autous meden pleon para to diatetagmenon humin prassete
eperoton de auton kai strateuomenoi legontes kai hemeis ti poiesomen kai eipen pros autous medena diaseisete mede sukophantesete kai arkeisthe tois opsoniois humon
prosdokontos de tou laou kai dialogizomenon panton en tais kardiais auton peri tou ioannou mepote autos eie ho christos

apekrinato ho ioannes hapasin legon ego men hudati baptizo humas erchetai de ho ischuroteros mou hou ouk eimi hikanos lusai ton himanta ton hupodematon autou autos humas baptisei en pneumati hagio kai puri
hou to ptuon en te cheiri autou kai diakathariei ten halona autou kai sunaxei ton siton eis ten apotheken autou to de achuron katakausei puri asbesto
polla men oun kai hetera parakalon euenelizeto ton laon
ho de herodes ho tetrarches elenchomenos hup autou peri herodiados tes gunaikos philippou tou adelphou autou kai peri panton hon epoiesen poneron ho herodes
prosetheken kai touto epi pasin kai katekleisen ton ioannen en te phulake
egeneto de en to baptisthenai hapanta ton laon kai iesou baptisthentos kai proseuchomenou aneochthenai ton ouranon
kai katabenai to pneuma to hagion somatiko eidei hosei peristeran ep auton kai phonen ex ouranou genesthai legousan su ei ho huios mou ho agapetos en soi eudokesa
kai autos en ho iesous hosei eton triakonta archomenos on hos enomizeto huios ioseph tou eli
tou matthat tou leui tou melchi tou ianna tou ioseph
tou mattathiou tou amos tou naoum tou hesli tou nanai
tou maath tou mattathiou tou semei tou ioseph tou iouda
tou ioanna tou hresa tou zorobabel tou salathiel tou neri
tou melchi tou addi tou kosam tou elmodam tou er
tou iose tou eliezer tou ioreim tou matthat tou leui
tou sumeon tou iouda tou ioseph tou ionan tou eliakeim
tou melea tou mainan tou mattatha tou nathan tou dabid
tou iessai tou obed tou booz tou salmon tou naasson
tou aminadab tou aram tou hesrom tou phares tou iouda
tou iakob tou isaak tou abraam tou thara tou nachor
tou sarouch tou hragau tou phalek tou eber tou sala
tou kainan tou arphaxad tou sem tou noe tou lamech
tou mathousala tou henoch tou iared tou maleleel tou kainan
tou enos tou seth tou adam tou theou
iesous de pneumatos hagiou pleres hupestrepsen apo tou iordanou kai egeto en to pneumati eis ten eremon
hemeras tessarakonta peirazomenos hupo tou diabolou kai ouk ephagen ouden en tais hemerais ekeinais kai suntelestheison auton husteron epeinasen
kai eipen auto ho diabolos ei huios ei tou theou eipe to litho touto hina genetai artos
kai apekrithe iesous pros auton legon gegraptai hoti ouk ep arto mono zesetai ho anthropos all epi panti hremati theou
kai anagagon auton ho diabolos eis oros hupselon edeixen auto pasas tas basileias tes oikoumenes en stigme chronou
kai eipen auto ho diabolos soi doso ten exousian tauten hapasan kai ten doxan auton hoti emoi paradedotai kai ho ean thelo didomi auten
su oun ean proskuneses enopion mou estai sou panta
kai apokritheis auto eipen ho iesous hupage opiso mou satana gegraptai gar proskuneseis kurion ton theon sou kai auto mono latreuseis
kai egagen auton eis ierousalem kai estesen auton epi to pterugion tou hierou kai eipen auto ei ho huios ei tou theou bale seauton enteuthen kato
gegraptai gar hoti tois anelois autou enteleitai peri sou tou diaphulaxai se
kai hoti epi cheiron arousin se mepote proskopses pros lithon ton poda sou
kai apokritheis eipen auto ho iesous hoti eiretai ouk ekpeiraseis kurion ton theon sou
kai suntelesas panta peirasmon ho diabolos apeste ap autou achri kairou
kai hupestrepsen ho iesous en te dunamei tou pneumatos eis ten galilaian kai pheme exelthen kath holes tes perichorou peri autou
kai autos edidasken en tais sunagogais auton doxazomenos hupo panton
kai elthen eis ten nazaret hou en tethrammenos kai eiselthen kata to eiothos auto en te hemera ton sabbaton eis ten sunagogen kai aneste anagnonai
kai epedothe auto biblion esaiou tou prophetou kai anaptuxas to biblion heuren ton topon hou en gegrammenon

pneuma kuriou ep eme hou heneken echrisen me euanelizesthai ptochois apestalken me iasasthai tous suntetrimmenous ten kardian keruxai aichmalotois aphesin kai tuphlois anablepsin aposteilai tethrausmenous en aphesei
keruxai eniauton kuriou dekton
kai ptuxas to biblion apodous to huperete ekathisen kai panton en te sunagoge hoi ophthalmoi esan atenizontes auto
erxato de legein pros autous hoti semeron peplerotai he graphe haute en tois osin humon
kai pantes emarturoun auto kai ethaumazon epi tois logois tes charitos tois ekporeuomenois ek tou stomatos autou kai elegon ouch houtos estin ho huios ioseph
kai eipen pros autous pantos ereite moi ten parabolen tauten iatre therapeuson seauton hosa ekousamen genomena en te kapernaoum poieson kai hode en te patridi sou
eipen de amen lego humin hoti oudeis prophetes dektos estin en te patridi autou
ep aletheias de lego humin pollai cherai esan en tais hemerais eliou en to israel hote ekleisthe ho ouranos epi ete tria kai menas hex hos egeneto limos megas epi pasan ten gen
kai pros oudemian auton epemphthe elias ei me eis sarepta tes sidonos pros gunaika cheran
kai polloi leproi esan epi elissaiou tou prophetou en to israel kai oudeis auton ekatharisthe ei me neeman ho suros
kai eplesthesan pantes thumou en te sunagoge akouontes tauta
kai anastantes exebalon auton exo tes poleos kai egagon auton heos tes ophruos tou orous eph hou he polis auton okodometo eis to katakremnisai auton
autos de dielthon dia mesou auton eporeueto
kai katelthen eis kapernaoum polin tes galilaias kai en didaskon autous en tois sabbasin
kai exeplessonto epi te didache autou hoti en exousia en ho logos autou
kai en te sunagoge en anthropos echon pneuma daimoniou akathartou kai anekraxen phone megale
legon ea ti hemin kai soi iesou nazarene elthes apolesai hemas oida se tis ei ho hagios tou theou
kai epetimesen auto ho iesous legon phimotheti kai exelthe ex autou kai hripsan auton to daimonion eis to meson exelthen ap autou meden blapsan auton
kai egeneto thambos epi pantas kai sunelaloun pros allelous legontes tis ho logos houtos hoti en exousia kai dunamei epitassei tois akathartois pneumasin kai exerchontai
kai exeporeueto echos peri autou eis panta topon tes perichorou
anastas de ek tes sunagoges eiselthen eis ten oikian simonos he penthera de tou simonos en sunechomene pureto megalo kai erotesan auton peri autes
kai epistas epano autes epetimesen to pureto kai apheken auten parachrema de anastasa diekonei autois
dunontos de tou heliou pantes hosoi eichon asthenountas nosois poikilais egagon autous pros auton ho de heni hekasto auton tas cheiras epitheis etherapeusen autous
exercheto de kai daimonia apo pollon krazonta kai legonta hoti su ei ho christos ho huios tou theou kai epitimon ouk eia auta lalein hoti edeisan ton christon auton einai
genomenes de hemeras exelthon eporeuthe eis eremon topon kai hoi ochloi ezetoun auton kai elthon heos autou kai kateichon auton tou me poreuesthai ap auton
ho de eipen pros autous hoti kai tais heterais polesin euanelisasthai me dei ten basileian tou theou hoti eis touto apestalmai
kai en kerusson en tais sunagogais tes galilaias
egeneto de en to ton ochlon epikeisthai auto tou akouein ton logon tou theou kai autos en hestos para ten limnen gennesaret
kai eiden duo ploia hestota para ten limnen hoi de halieis apobantes ap auton apeplunan ta diktua
embas de eis hen ton ploion ho en tou simonos erotesen auton apo tes ges epanagagein oligon kai kathisas edidasken ek tou ploiou tous ochlous
hos de epausato lalon eipen pros ton simona epanagage eis to bathos kai chalasate ta diktua humon eis agran
kai apokritheis ho simon eipen auto epistata di holes tes nuktos kopiasantes ouden elabomen epi de to hremati sou chalaso to diktuon
kai touto poiesantes sunekleisan ichthuon plethos polu dierregnuto de to diktuon auton
kai kateneusan tois metochois tois en to hetero ploio tou elthontas sullabesthai autois kai elthon kai eplesan amphotera ta ploia hoste buthizesthai auta
idon de simon petros prosepesen tois gonasin tou iesou legon exelthe ap emou hoti aner hamartolos eimi kurie
thambos gar perieschen auton kai pantas tous sun auto epi te agra ton ichthuon he sunelabon
homoios de kai iakobon kai ioannen huious zebedaiou hoi esan koinonoi to simoni kai eipen pros ton simona ho iesous me phobou apo tou nun anthropous ese zogron
kai katagagontes ta ploia epi ten gen aphentes hapanta ekolouthesan auto
kai egeneto en to einai auton en mia ton poleon kai idou aner pleres lepras kai idon ton iesoun peson epi prosopon edeethe autou legon kurie ean theles dunasai me katharisai
kai ekteinas ten cheira hepsato autou eipon thelo katharistheti kai eutheos he lepra apelthen ap autou
kai autos pareneilen auto medeni eipein alla apelthon deixon seauton to hierei kai prosenenke peri tou katharismou sou kathos prosetaxen moses eis marturion autois
diercheto de mallon ho logos peri autou kai sunerchonto ochloi polloi akouein kai therapeuesthai hup autou apo ton astheneion auton
autos de en hupochoron en tais eremois kai proseuchomenos

kai egeneto en mia ton hemeron kai autos en didaskon kai esan kathemenoi pharisaioi kai nomodidaskaloi hoi esan eleluthotes ek pases komes tes galilaias kai ioudaias kai ierousalem kai dunamis kuriou en eis to iasthai autous
kai idou andres pherontes epi klines anthropon hos en paralelumenos kai ezetoun auton eisenenkein kai theinai enopion autou
kai me heurontes dia poias eisenenkosin auton dia ton ochlon anabantes epi to doma dia ton keramon kathekan auton sun to klinidio eis to meson emprosthen tou iesou
kai idon ten pistin auton eipen auto anthrope apheontai soi hai hamartiai sou
kai erxanto dialogizesthai hoi grammateis kai hoi pharisaioi legontes tis estin houtos hos lalei blasphemias tis dunatai aphienai hamartias ei me monos ho theos
epignous de ho iesous tous dialogismous auton apokritheis eipen pros autous ti dialogizesthe en tais kardiais humon
ti estin eukopoteron eipein apheontai soi hai hamartiai sou e eipein egeirai kai peripatei
hina de eidete hoti exousian echei ho huios tou anthropou epi tes ges aphienai hamartias eipen to paralelumeno soi lego egeirai kai aras to klinidion sou poreuou eis ton oikon sou
kai parachrema anastas enopion auton aras eph ho katekeito apelthen eis ton oikon autou doxazon ton theon

touto de ginoskete hoti ei edei ho oikodespotes poia hora ho kleptes erchetai egregoresen an kai ouk an apheken diorugenai ton oikon autou
kai humeis oun ginesthe hetoimoi hoti he hora ou dokeite ho huios tou anthropou erchetai
eipen de auto ho petros kurie pros hemas ten parabolen tauten legeis e kai pros pantas
eipen de ho kurios tis ara estin ho pistos oikonomos kai phronimos hon katastesei ho kurios epi tes therapeias autou tou didonai en kairo to sitometrion
makarios ho doulos ekeinos hon elthon ho kurios autou heuresei poiounta houtos
alethos lego humin hoti epi pasin tois huparchousin autou katastesei auton
ean de eipe ho doulos ekeinos en te kardia autou chronizei ho kurios mou erchesthai kai arxetai tuptein tous paidas kai tas paidiskas esthiein te kai pinein kai methuskesthai
hexei ho kurios tou doulou ekeinou en hemera he ou prosdoka kai en hora he ou ginoskei kai dichotomesei auton kai to meros autou meta ton apiston thesei
ekeinos de ho doulos ho gnous to thelema tou kuriou heautou kai me hetoimasas mede poiesas pros to thelema autou daresetai pollas
ho de me gnous poiesas de axia plegon daresetai oligas panti de ho edothe polu polu zetethesetai par autou kai ho parethento polu perissoteron aitesousin auton
pur elthon balein eis ten gen kai ti thelo ei ede anephthe
baptisma de echo baptisthenai kai pos sunechomai heos hou telesthe
dokeite hoti eirenen paregenomen dounai en te ge ouchi lego humin all e diamerismon
esontai gar apo tou nun pente en oiko heni diamemerismenoi treis epi dusin kai duo epi trisin
diameristhesetai pater eph huio kai huios epi patri meter epi thugatri kai thugater epi metri penthera epi ten numphen autes kai numphe epi ten pentheran autes
elegen de kai tois ochlois hotan idete ten nephelen anatellousan apo dusmon eutheos legete ombros erchetai kai ginetai houtos
kai hotan noton pneonta legete hoti kauson estai kai ginetai
hupokritai to prosopon tes ges kai tou ouranou oidate dokimazein ton de kairon touton pos ou dokimazete
ti de kai aph heauton ou krinete to dikaion

hos gar hupageis meta tou antidikou sou ep archonta en te hodo dos ergasian apellachthai ap autou mepote katasure se pros ton kriten kai ho krites se parado to praktori kai ho praktor se balle eis phulaken
lego soi ou me exelthes ekeithen heos hou kai to eschaton lepton apodos
paresan de tines en auto to kairo apanellontes auto peri ton galilaion hon to haima pilatos emixen meta ton thusion auton
kai apokritheis ho iesous eipen autois dokeite hoti hoi galilaioi houtoi hamartoloi para pantas tous galilaious egenonto hoti toiauta peponthasin
ouchi lego humin all ean me metanoete pantes hosautos apoleisthe
e ekeinoi hoi deka kai okto eph hous epesen ho purgos en to siloam kai apekteinen autous dokeite hoti houtoi opheiletai egenonto para pantas anthropous tous katoikountas en ierousalem
ouchi lego humin all ean me metanoete pantes homoios apoleisthe
elegen de tauten ten parabolen suken eichen tis en to ampeloni autou pephuteumenen kai elthen karpon zeton en aute kai ouch heuren
eipen de pros ton ampelourgon idou tria ete erchomai zeton karpon en te suke taute kai ouch heurisko ekkopson auten hina ti kai ten gen katargei
ho de apokritheis legei auto kurie aphes auten kai touto to etos heos hotou skapso peri auten kai balo koprian
kan men poiese karpon ei de mege eis to mellon ekkopseis auten
en de didaskon en mia ton sunagogon en tois sabbasin
kai idou gune en pneuma echousa astheneias ete deka kai okto kai en sunkuptousa kai me dunamene anakupsai eis to panteles
idon de auten ho iesous prosephonesen kai eipen aute gunai apolelusai tes astheneias sou
kai epetheken aute tas cheiras kai parachrema anorthothe kai edoxazen ton theon

apokritheis de ho archisunagogos aganakton hoti to sabbato etherapeusen ho iesous elegen to ochlo hex hemerai eisin en hais dei ergazesthai en tautais oun erchomenoi therapeuesthe kai me te hemera tou sabbatou
apekrithe oun auto ho kurios kai eipen hupokrita hekastos humon to sabbato ou luei ton boun autou e ton onon apo tes phatnes kai apagagon potizei
tauten de thugatera abraam ousan hen edesen ho satanas idou deka kai okto ete ouk edei luthenai apo tou desmou toutou te hemera tou sabbatou
kai tauta legontos autou kateschunonto pantes hoi antikeimenoi auto kai pas ho ochlos echairen epi pasin tois endoxois tois ginomenois hup autou
elegen de tini homoia estin he basileia tou theou kai tini homoioso auten
homoia estin kokko sinapeos hon labon anthropos ebalen eis kepon heautou kai euxesen kai egeneto eis dendron mega kai ta peteina tou ouranou kateskenosen en tois kladois autou
kai palin eipen tini homoioso ten basileian tou theou
homoia estin zume hen labousa gune enekrupsen eis aleurou sata tria heos hou ezumothe holon
kai dieporeueto kata poleis kai komas didaskon kai poreian poioumenos eis ierousalem
eipen de tis auto kurie ei oligoi hoi sozomenoi ho de eipen pros autous
agonizesthe eiselthein dia tes stenes pules hoti polloi lego humin zetesousin eiselthein kai ouk ischusousin
aph hou an egerthe ho oikodespotes kai apokleise ten thuran kai arxesthe exo hestanai kai krouein ten thuran legontes kurie kurie anoixon hemin kai apokritheis erei humin ouk oida humas pothen este
tote arxesthe legein ephagomen enopion sou kai epiomen kai en tais plateiais hemon edidaxas
kai erei lego humin ouk oida humas pothen este apostete ap emou pantes hoi ergatai tes adikias
ekei estai ho klauthmos kai ho brugmos ton odonton hotan opsesthe abraam kai isaak kai iakob kai pantas tous prophetas en te basileia tou theou humas de ekballomenous exo
kai hexousin apo anatolon kai dusmon kai apo borra kai notou kai anaklithesontai en te basileia tou theou
kai idou eisin eschatoi hoi esontai protoi kai eisin protoi hoi esontai eschatoi
en aute te hemera proselthon tines pharisaioi legontes auto exelthe kai poreuou enteuthen hoti herodes thelei se apokteinai
kai eipen autois poreuthentes eipate te alopeki taute idou ekballo daimonia kai iaseis epitelo semeron kai aurion kai te trite teleioumai
plen dei me semeron kai aurion kai te echomene poreuesthai hoti ouk endechetai propheten apolesthai exo ierousalem

ierousalem ierousalem he apokteinousa tous prophetas kai lithobolousa tous apestalmenous pros auten posakis ethelesa episunaxai ta tekna sou hon tropon ornis ten heautes nossian hupo tas pterugas kai ouk ethelesate
idou aphietai humin ho oikos humon eremos amen de lego humin hoti ou me me idete heos an hexe hote eipete eulogemenos ho erchomenos en onomati kuriou
kai egeneto en to elthein auton eis oikon tinos ton archonton ton pharisaion sabbato phagein arton kai autoi esan parateroumenoi auton
kai idou anthropos tis en hudropikos emprosthen autou
kai apokritheis ho iesous eipen pros tous nomikous kai pharisaious legon ei exestin to sabbato therapeuein
hoi de hesuchasan kai epilabomenos iasato auton kai apelusen
kai apokritheis pros autous eipen tinos humon onos e bous eis phrear empeseitai kai ouk eutheos anaspasei auton en te hemera tou sabbatou
kai ouk ischusan antapokrithenai auto pros tauta
elegen de pros tous keklemenous parabolen epechon pos tas protoklisias exelegonto legon pros autous
hotan klethes hupo tinos eis gamous me kataklithes eis ten protoklisian mepote entimoteros sou e keklemenos hup autou
kai elthon ho se kai auton kalesas erei soi dos touto topon kai tote arxe met aischunes ton eschaton topon katechein
all hotan klethes poreutheis anapeson eis ton eschaton topon hina hotan elthe ho keklekos se eipe soi phile prosanabethi anoteron tote estai soi doxa enopion ton sunanakeimenon soi
hoti pas ho hupson heauton tapeinothesetai kai ho tapeinon heauton hupsothesetai

elegen de kai to keklekoti auton hotan poies ariston e deipnon me phonei tous philous sou mede tous adelphous sou mede tous suneneis sou mede geitonas plousious mepote kai autoi se antikalesosin kai genetai soi antapodoma
all hotan poies dochen kalei ptochous anaperous cholous tuphlous
kai makarios ese hoti ouk echousin antapodounai soi antapodothesetai gar soi en te anastasei ton dikaion
akousas de tis ton sunanakeimenon tauta eipen auto makarios hos phagetai arton en te basileia tou theou
ho de eipen auto anthropos tis epoiesen deipnon mega kai ekalesen pollous
kai apesteilen ton doulon autou te hora tou deipnou eipein tois keklemenois erchesthe hoti ede hetoima estin panta
kai erxanto apo mias paraiteisthai pantes ho protos eipen auto agron egorasa kai echo ananken exelthein kai idein auton eroto se eche me paretemenon
kai heteros eipen zeuge boon egorasa pente kai poreuomai dokimasai auta eroto se eche me paretemenon
kai heteros eipen gunaika egema kai dia touto ou dunamai elthein

kai paragenomenos ho doulos ekeinos apeneilen to kurio autou tauta tote orgistheis ho oikodespotes eipen to doulo autou exelthe tacheos eis tas plateias kai hrumas tes poleos kai tous ptochous kai anaperous kai cholous kai tuphlous eisagage hode
kai eipen ho doulos kurie gegonen hos epetaxas kai eti topos estin
kai eipen ho kurios pros ton doulon exelthe eis tas hodous kai phragmous kai anankason eiselthein hina gemisthe ho oikos mou
lego gar humin hoti oudeis ton andron ekeinon ton keklemenon geusetai mou tou deipnou
suneporeuonto de auto ochloi polloi kai strapheis eipen pros autous
ei tis erchetai pros me kai ou misei ton patera heautou kai ten metera kai ten gunaika kai ta tekna kai tous adelphous kai tas adelphas eti de kai ten heautou psuchen ou dunatai mou mathetes einai
kai hostis ou bastazei ton stauron autou kai erchetai opiso mou ou dunatai mou einai mathetes
tis gar ex humon thelon purgon oikodomesai ouchi proton kathisas psephizei ten dapanen ei echei ta pros apartismon
hina mepote thentos autou themelion kai me ischuontos ektelesai pantes hoi theorountes arxontai empaizein auto
legontes hoti houtos ho anthropos erxato oikodomein kai ouk ischusen ektelesai
e tis basileus poreuomenos sumbalein hetero basilei eis polemon ouchi kathisas proton bouleuetai ei dunatos estin en deka chiliasin apantesai to meta eikosi chiliadon erchomeno ep auton
ei de mege eti autou porro ontos presbeian aposteilas erota ta pros eirenen
houtos oun pas ex humon hos ouk apotassetai pasin tois heautou huparchousin ou dunatai mou einai mathetes
kalon to halas ean de to halas moranthe en tini artuthesetai
oute eis gen oute eis koprian eutheton estin exo ballousin auto ho echon ota akouein akoueto
esan de enizontes auto pantes hoi telonai kai hoi hamartoloi akouein autou
kai diegonuzon hoi pharisaioi kai hoi grammateis legontes hoti houtos hamartolous prosdechetai kai sunesthiei autois
eipen de pros autous ten parabolen tauten legon
tis anthropos ex humon echon hekaton probata kai apolesas hen ex auton ou kataleipei ta ennenekontaennea en te eremo kai poreuetai epi to apololos heos heure auto
kai heuron epitithesin epi tous omous heautou chairon
kai elthon eis ton oikon sunkalei tous philous kai tous geitonas legon autois suncharete moi hoti heuron to probaton mou to apololos
lego humin hoti houtos chara estai en to ourano epi heni hamartolo metanoounti e epi ennenekontaennea dikaiois hoitines ou chreian echousin metanoias
e tis gune drachmas echousa deka ean apolese drachmen mian ouchi haptei luchnon kai saroi ten oikian kai zetei epimelos heos hotou heure
kai heurousa sunkaleitai tas philas kai tas geitonas legousa suncharete moi hoti heuron ten drachmen hen apolesa
houtos lego humin chara ginetai enopion ton anelon tou theou epi heni hamartolo metanoounti
eipen de anthropos tis eichen duo huious
kai eipen ho neoteros auton to patri pater dos moi to epiballon meros tes ousias kai dieilen autois ton bion
kai met ou pollas hemeras sunagagon hapanta ho neoteros huios apedemesen eis choran makran kai ekei dieskorpisen ten ousian autou zon asotos
dapanesantos de autou panta egeneto limos ischuros kata ten choran ekeinen kai autos erxato hustereisthai
kai poreutheis ekollethe heni ton politon tes choras ekeines kai epempsen auton eis tous agrous autou boskein choirous
kai epethumei gemisai ten koilian autou apo ton keration hon esthion hoi choiroi kai oudeis edidou auto
eis heauton de elthon eipen posoi misthioi tou patros mou perisseuousin arton ego de limo apollumai
anastas poreusomai pros ton patera mou kai ero auto pater hemarton eis ton ouranon kai enopion sou
kai ouketi eimi axios klethenai huios sou poieson me hos hena ton misthion sou
kai anastas elthen pros ton patera heautou eti de autou makran apechontos eiden auton ho pater autou kai esplanchnisthe kai dramon epepesen epi ton trachelon autou kai katephilesen auton
eipen de auto ho huios pater hemarton eis ton ouranon kai enopion sou kai ouketi eimi axios klethenai huios sou
eipen de ho pater pros tous doulous autou exenenkate ten stolen ten proten kai endusate auton kai dote daktulion eis ten cheira autou kai hupodemata eis tous podas
kai enenkantes ton moschon ton siteuton thusate kai phagontes euphranthomen
hoti houtos ho huios mou nekros en kai anezesen kai apololos en kai heurethe kai erxanto euphrainesthai
en de ho huios autou ho presbuteros en agro kai hos erchomenos enisen te oikia ekousen sumphonias kai choron
kai proskalesamenos hena ton paidon autou epunthaneto ti eie tauta
ho de eipen auto hoti ho adelphos sou hekei kai ethusen ho pater sou ton moschon ton siteuton hoti hugiainonta auton apelaben
orgisthe de kai ouk ethelen eiselthein ho oun pater autou exelthon parekalei auton
ho de apokritheis eipen to patri idou tosauta ete douleuo soi kai oudepote entolen sou parelthon kai emoi oudepote edokas eriphon hina meta ton philon mou euphrantho
hote de ho huios sou houtos ho kataphagon sou ton bion meta pornon elthen ethusas auto ton moschon ton siteuton
ho de eipen auto teknon su pantote met emou ei kai panta ta ema sa estin
euphranthenai de kai charenai edei hoti ho adelphos sou houtos nekros en kai anezesen kai apololos en kai heurethe
elegen de kai pros tous mathetas autou anthropos tis en plousios hos eichen oikonomon kai houtos dieblethe auto hos diaskorpizon ta huparchonta autou
kai phonesas auton eipen auto ti touto akouo peri sou apodos ton logon tes oikonomias sou ou gar dunese eti oikonomein
eipen de en heauto ho oikonomos ti poieso hoti ho kurios mou aphaireitai ten oikonomian ap emou skaptein ouk ischuo epaitein aischunomai
egnon ti poieso hina hotan metastatho tes oikonomias dexontai me eis tous oikous auton
kai proskalesamenos hena hekaston ton chreopheileton tou kuriou heautou elegen to proto poson opheileis to kurio mou
ho de eipen hekaton batous elaiou kai eipen auto dexai sou to gramma kai kathisas tacheos grapson pentekonta
epeita hetero eipen su de poson opheileis ho de eipen hekaton korous sitou kai legei auto dexai sou to gramma kai grapson ogdoekonta
kai epenesen ho kurios ton oikonomon tes adikias hoti phronimos epoiesen hoti hoi huioi tou aionos toutou phronimoteroi huper tous huious tou photos eis ten genean ten heauton eisin
kago humin lego poiesate heautois philous ek tou mamona tes adikias hina hotan eklipete dexontai humas eis tas aionious skenas
ho pistos en elachisto kai en pollo pistos estin kai ho en elachisto adikos kai en pollo adikos estin
ei oun en to adiko mamona pistoi ouk egenesthe to alethinon tis humin pisteusei
kai ei en to allotrio pistoi ouk egenesthe to humeteron tis humin dosei
oudeis oiketes dunatai dusin kuriois douleuein e gar ton hena misesei kai ton heteron agapesei e henos anthexetai kai tou heterou kataphronesei ou dunasthe theo douleuein kai mamona
ekouon de tauta panta kai hoi pharisaioi philarguroi huparchontes kai exemukterizon auton
kai eipen autois humeis este hoi dikaiountes heautous enopion ton anthropon ho de theos ginoskei tas kardias humon hoti to en anthropois hupselon bdelugma enopion tou theou estin
ho nomos kai hoi prophetai heos ioannou apo tote he basileia tou theou euanelizetai kai pas eis auten biazetai
eukopoteron de estin ton ouranon kai ten gen parelthein e tou nomou mian keraian pesein
pas ho apoluon ten gunaika autou kai gamon heteran moicheuei kai pas ho apolelumenen apo andros gamon moicheuei
anthropos de tis en plousios kai enedidusketo porphuran kai busson euphrainomenos kath hemeran lampros
ptochos de tis en onomati lazaros hos ebebleto pros ton pulona autou helkomenos
kai epithumon chortasthenai apo ton psichion ton piptonton apo tes trapezes tou plousiou alla kai hoi kunes erchomenoi apeleichon ta helke autou
egeneto de apothanein ton ptochon kai apenechthenai auton hupo ton anelon eis ton kolpon tou abraam apethanen de kai ho plousios kai etaphe
kai en to hade eparas tous ophthalmous autou huparchon en basanois hora ton abraam apo makrothen kai lazaron en tois kolpois autou
kai autos phonesas eipen pater abraam eleeson me kai pempson lazaron hina bapse to akron tou daktulou autou hudatos kai katapsuxe ten glossan mou hoti odunomai en te phlogi taute
eipen de abraam teknon mnestheti hoti apelabes su ta agatha sou en te zoe sou kai lazaros homoios ta kaka nun de hode parakaleitai su de odunasai
kai epi pasin toutois metaxu hemon kai humon chasma mega esteriktai hopos hoi thelontes diabenai enteuthen pros humas me dunontai mede hoi ekeithen pros hemas diaperosin
eipen de eroto oun se pater hina pempses auton eis ton oikon tou patros mou
echo gar pente adelphous hopos diamarturetai autois hina me kai autoi elthosin eis ton topon touton tes basanou
legei auto abraam echousin mosea kai tous prophetas akousatosan auton
ho de eipen ouchi pater abraam all ean tis apo nekron poreuthe pros autous metanoesousin
eipen de auto ei moseos kai ton propheton ouk akouousin oude ean tis ek nekron anaste peisthesontai
eipen de pros tous mathetas anendekton estin tou me elthein ta skandala ouai de di hou erchetai
lusitelei auto ei mulos onikos perikeitai peri ton trachelon autou kai erriptai eis ten thalassan e hina skandalise hena ton mikron touton
prosechete heautois ean de hamarte eis se ho adelphos sou epitimeson auto kai ean metanoese aphes auto
kai ean heptakis tes hemeras hamarte eis se kai heptakis tes hemeras epistrepse epi se legon metanoo apheseis auto
kai eipon hoi apostoloi to kurio prosthes hemin pistin
eipen de ho kurios ei eichete pistin hos kokkon sinapeos elegete an te sukamino taute ekrizotheti kai phuteutheti en te thalasse kai hupekousen an humin
tis de ex humon doulon echon arotrionta e poimainonta hos eiselthonti ek tou agrou erei eutheos parelthon anapesai
all ouchi erei auto hetoimason ti deipneso kai perizosamenos diakonei moi heos phago kai pio kai meta tauta phagesai kai piesai su
me charin echei to doulo ekeino hoti epoiesen ta diatachthenta auto ou doko
houtos kai humeis hotan poiesete panta ta diatachthenta humin legete hoti douloi achreioi esmen hoti ho opheilomen poiesai pepoiekamen
kai egeneto en to poreuesthai auton eis ierousalem kai autos diercheto dia mesou samareias kai galilaias
kai eiserchomenou autou eis tina komen apentesan auto deka leproi andres hoi estesan porrothen
kai autoi eran phonen legontes iesou epistata eleeson hemas
kai idon eipen autois poreuthentes epideixate heautous tois hiereusin kai egeneto en to hupagein autous ekatharisthesan
heis de ex auton idon hoti iathe hupestrepsen meta phones megales doxazon ton theon
kai epesen epi prosopon para tous podas autou euchariston auto kai autos en samareites
apokritheis de ho iesous eipen ouchi hoi deka ekatharisthesan hoi de ennea pou
ouch heurethesan hupostrepsantes dounai doxan to theo ei me ho allogenes houtos
kai eipen auto anastas poreuou he pistis sou sesoken se
eperotetheis de hupo ton pharisaion pote erchetai he basileia tou theou apekrithe autois kai eipen ouk erchetai he basileia tou theou meta paratereseos
oude erousin idou hode e idou ekei idou gar he basileia tou theou entos humon estin
eipen de pros tous mathetas eleusontai hemerai hote epithumesete mian ton hemeron tou huiou tou anthropou idein kai ouk opsesthe
kai erousin humin idou hode e idou ekei me apelthete mede dioxete
hosper gar he astrape he astraptousa ek tes hup ouranon eis ten hup ouranon lampei houtos estai kai ho huios tou anthropou en te hemera autou
proton de dei auton polla pathein kai apodokimasthenai apo tes geneas tautes
kai kathos egeneto en tais hemerais tou noe houtos estai kai en tais hemerais tou huiou tou anthropou
esthion epinon egamoun exegamizonto achri hes hemeras eiselthen noe eis ten kiboton kai elthen ho kataklusmos kai apolesen hapantas
homoios kai hos egeneto en tais hemerais lot esthion epinon egorazon epoloun ephuteuon okodomoun
he de hemera exelthen lot apo sodomon ebrexen pur kai theion ap ouranou kai apolesen hapantas
kata tauta estai he hemera ho huios tou anthropou apokaluptetai
en ekeine te hemera hos estai epi tou domatos kai ta skeue autou en te oikia me katabato arai auta kai ho en to agro homoios me epistrepsato eis ta opiso
mnemoneuete tes gunaikos lot
hos ean zetese ten psuchen autou sosai apolesei auten kai hos ean apolese auten zoogonesei auten
lego humin taute te nukti esontai duo epi klines mias ho heis paralephthesetai kai ho heteros aphethesetai
duo esontai alethousai epi to auto mia paralephthesetai kai he hetera aphethesetai

eipen de pros autous ouch humon estin gnonai chronous e kairous hous ho pater etheto en te idia exousia
alla lepsesthe dunamin epelthontos tou hagiou pneumatos eph humas kai esesthe moi martures en te ierousalem kai en pase te ioudaia kai samareia kai heos eschatou tes ges
kai tauta eipon bleponton auton eperthe kai nephele hupelaben auton apo ton ophthalmon auton
kai hos atenizontes esan eis ton ouranon poreuomenou autou kai idou andres duo pareistekeisan autois en estheti leuke

hoi kai eipon andres galilaioi ti hestekate emblepontes eis ton ouranon houtos ho iesous ho analephtheis aph humon eis ton ouranon houtos eleusetai hon tropon etheasasthe auton poreuomenon eis ton ouranon
tote hupestrepsan eis ierousalem apo orous tou kaloumenou elaionos ho estin enus ierousalem sabbatou echon hodon

kai hote eiselthon anebesan eis to huperoon hou esan katamenontes ho te petros kai iakobos kai ioannes kai andreas philippos kai thomas bartholomaios kai matthaios iakobos halphaiou kai simon ho zelotes kai ioudas iakobou
houtoi pantes esan proskarterountes homothumadon te proseuche kai te deesei sun gunaixin kai maria te metri tou iesou kai sun tois adelphois autou
kai en tais hemerais tautais anastas petros en meso ton matheton eipen en te ochlos onomaton epi to auto hos hekaton eikosin
andres adelphoi edei plerothenai ten graphen tauten hen proeipen to pneuma to hagion dia stomatos dabid peri iouda tou genomenou hodegou tois sullabousin ton iesoun
hoti katerithmemenos en sun hemin kai elachen ton kleron tes diakonias tautes
houtos men oun ektesato chorion ek tou misthou tes adikias kai prenes genomenos elakesen mesos kai exechuthe panta ta splanchna autou
kai gnoston egeneto pasin tois katoikousin ierousalem hoste klethenai to chorion ekeino te idia dialekto auton akeldama tout estin chorion haimatos
gegraptai gar en biblo psalmon genetheto he epaulis autou eremos kai me esto ho katoikon en aute kai ten episkopen autou laboi heteros
dei oun ton sunelthonton hemin andron en panti chrono en ho eiselthen kai exelthen eph hemas ho kurios iesous
arxamenos apo tou baptismatos ioannou heos tes hemeras hes anelephthe aph hemon martura tes anastaseos autou genesthai sun hemin hena touton
kai estesan duo ioseph ton kaloumenon barsaban hos epeklethe ioustos kai matthian
kai proseuxamenoi eipon su kurie kardiognosta panton anadeixon ek touton ton duo hena hon exelexo
labein ton kleron tes diakonias tautes kai apostoles ex hes parebe ioudas poreuthenai eis ton topon ton idion
kai edokan klerous auton kai epesen ho kleros epi matthian kai sunkatepsephisthe meta ton hendeka apostolon
kai en to sumplerousthai ten hemeran tes pentekostes esan hapantes homothumadon epi to auto
kai egeneto aphno ek tou ouranou echos hosper pheromenes pnoes biaias kai eplerosen holon ton oikon hou esan kathemenoi
kai ophthesan autois diamerizomenai glossai hosei puros ekathisen te eph hena hekaston auton
kai eplesthesan hapantes pneumatos hagiou kai erxanto lalein heterais glossais kathos to pneuma edidou autois apophthenesthai
esan de en ierousalem katoikountes ioudaioi andres eulabeis apo pantos ethnous ton hupo ton ouranon
genomenes de tes phones tautes sunelthen to plethos kai sunechuthe hoti ekouon heis hekastos te idia dialekto lalounton auton
existanto de pantes kai ethaumazon legontes pros allelous ouk idou pantes houtoi eisin hoi lalountes galilaioi
kai pos hemeis akouomen hekastos te idia dialekto hemon en he egennethemen
parthoi kai medoi kai elamitai kai hoi katoikountes ten mesopotamian ioudaian te kai kappadokian ponton kai ten asian
phrugian te kai pamphulian aigupton kai ta mere tes libues tes kata kurenen kai hoi epidemountes hromaioi ioudaioi te kai proselutoi
kretes kai arabes akouomen lalounton auton tais hemeterais glossais ta megaleia tou theou
existanto de pantes kai dieporoun allos pros allon legontes ti an theloi touto einai
heteroi de chleuazontes elegon hoti gleukous memestomenoi eisin
statheis de petros sun tois hendeka eperen ten phonen autou kai apephthegxato autois andres ioudaioi kai hoi katoikountes ierousalem hapantes touto humin gnoston esto kai enotisasthe ta hremata mou
ou gar hos humeis hupolambanete houtoi methuousin estin gar hora trite tes hemeras
alla touto estin to eiremenon dia tou prophetou ioel

kai estai en tais eschatais hemerais legei ho theos ekcheo apo tou pneumatos mou epi pasan sarka kai propheteusousin hoi huioi humon kai hai thugateres humon kai hoi neaniskoi humon horaseis opsontai kai hoi presbuteroi humon enupnia enupniasthesontai
kai ge epi tous doulous mou kai epi tas doulas mou en tais hemerais ekeinais ekcheo apo tou pneumatos mou kai propheteusousin
kai doso terata en to ourano ano kai semeia epi tes ges kato haima kai pur kai atmida kapnou
ho helios metastraphesetai eis skotos kai he selene eis haima prin e elthein ten hemeran kuriou ten megalen kai epiphane
kai estai pas hos an epikalesetai to onoma kuriou sothesetai

andres israelitai akousate tous logous toutous iesoun ton nazoraion andra apo tou theou apodedeigmenon eis humas dunamesin kai terasin kai semeiois hois epoiesen di autou ho theos en meso humon kathos kai autoi oidate
touton te horismene boule kai prognosei tou theou ekdoton labontes dia cheiron anomon prospexantes aneilete
hon ho theos anestesen lusas tas odinas tou thanatou kathoti ouk en dunaton krateisthai auton hup autou
dabid gar legei eis auton prooromen ton kurion enopion mou dia pantos hoti ek dexion mou estin hina me saleutho
dia touto euphranthe he kardia mou kai egalliasato he glossa mou eti de kai he sarx mou kataskenosei ep elpidi
hoti ouk enkataleipseis ten psuchen mou eis hadou oude doseis ton hosion sou idein diaphthoran
egnorisas moi hodous zoes pleroseis me euphrosunes meta tou prosopou sou
andres adelphoi exon eipein meta parresias pros humas peri tou patriarchou dabid hoti kai eteleutesen kai etaphe kai to mnema autou estin en hemin achri tes hemeras tautes
prophetes oun huparchon kai eidos hoti horko omosen auto ho theos ek karpou tes osphuos autou to kata sarka anastesein ton christon kathisai epi tou thronou autou
proidon elalesen peri tes anastaseos tou christou hoti ou kateleiphthe he psuche autou eis hadou oude he sarx autou eiden diaphthoran
touton ton iesoun anestesen ho theos hou pantes hemeis esmen martures
te dexia oun tou theou hupsotheis ten te epanelian tou hagiou pneumatos labon para tou patros execheen touto ho nun humeis blepete kai akouete
