kai ex humon auton anastesontai andres lalountes diestrammena tou apospan tous mathetas opiso auton
dio gregoreite mnemoneuontes hoti trietian nukta kai hemeran ouk epausamen meta dakruon noutheton hena hekaston
kai tanun paratithemai humas adelphoi to theo kai to logo tes charitos autou to dunameno epoikodomesai kai dounai humin kleronomian en tois hegiasmenois pasin
arguriou e chrusiou e himatismou oudenos epethumesa
autoi de ginoskete hoti tais chreiais mou kai tois ousin met emou huperetesan hai cheires hautai
panta hupedeixa humin hoti houtos kopiontas dei antilambanesthai ton asthenounton mnemoneuein te ton logon tou kuriou iesou hoti autos eipen makarion estin didonai mallon e lambanein
kai tauta eipon theis ta gonata autou sun pasin autois proseuxato
hikanos de egeneto klauthmos panton kai epipesontes epi ton trachelon tou paulou katephiloun auton
odunomenoi malista epi to logo ho eirekei hoti ouketi mellousin to prosopon autou theorein proepempon de auton eis to ploion
hos de egeneto anachthenai hemas apospasthentas ap auton euthudromesantes elthomen eis ten kon te de hexes eis ten hrodon kakeithen eis patara
kai heurontes ploion diaperon eis phoiniken epibantes anechthemen
anaphanantes de ten kupron kai katalipontes auten euonumon epleomen eis surian kai katechthemen eis turon ekeise gar en to ploion apophortizomenon ton gomon
kai aneurontes tous mathetas epemeinamen autou hemeras hepta hoitines to paulo elegon dia tou pneumatos me anabainein eis ierousalem
hote de egeneto hemas exartisai tas hemeras exelthontes eporeuometha propemponton hemas panton sun gunaixin kai teknois heos exo tes poleos kai thentes ta gonata epi ton aigialon proseuxametha
kai aspasamenoi allelous epebemen eis to ploion ekeinoi de hupestrepsan eis ta idia
hemeis de ton ploun dianusantes apo turou katentesamen eis ptolemaida kai aspasamenoi tous adelphous emeinamen hemeran mian par autois
te de epaurion exelthontes hoi peri ton paulon elthon eis kaisareian kai eiselthontes eis ton oikon philippou tou euanelistou tou ontos ek ton hepta emeinamen par auto
touto de esan thugateres parthenoi tessares propheteuousai
epimenonton de hemon hemeras pleious katelthen tis apo tes ioudaias prophetes onomati hagabos

kai elthon pros hemas kai aras ten zonen tou paulou desas te autou tas cheiras kai tous podas eipen tade legei to pneuma to hagion ton andra hou estin he zone haute houtos desousin en ierousalem hoi ioudaioi kai paradosousin eis cheiras ethnon
hos de ekousamen tauta parekaloumen hemeis te kai hoi entopioi tou me anabainein auton eis ierousalem
apekrithe de ho paulos ti poieite klaiontes kai sunthruptontes mou ten kardian ego gar ou monon dethenai alla kai apothanein eis ierousalem hetoimos echo huper tou onomatos tou kuriou iesou
me peithomenou de autou hesuchasamen eipontes to thelema tou kuriou genestho
meta de tas hemeras tautas aposkeuasamenoi anebainomen eis ierousalem
sunelthon de kai ton matheton apo kaisareias sun hemin agontes par ho xenisthomen mnasoni tini kuprio archaio mathete
genomenon de hemon eis hierosoluma asmenos edexanto hemas hoi adelphoi
te de epiouse eiseei ho paulos sun hemin pros iakobon pantes te paregenonto hoi presbuteroi
kai aspasamenos autous exegeito kath hen hekaston hon epoiesen ho theos en tois ethnesin dia tes diakonias autou
hoi de akousantes edoxazon ton kurion eipon te auto theoreis adelphe posai muriades eisin ioudaion ton pepisteukoton kai pantes zelotai tou nomou huparchousin
katechethesan de peri sou hoti apostasian didaskeis apo moseos tous kata ta ethne pantas ioudaious legon me peritemnein autous ta tekna mede tois ethesin peripatein
ti oun estin pantos dei plethos sunelthein akousontai gar hoti eleluthas
touto oun poieson ho soi legomen eisin hemin andres tessares euchen echontes eph heauton
toutous paralabon hagnistheti sun autois kai dapaneson ep autois hina xuresontai ten kephalen kai gnosin pantes hoti hon katechentai peri sou ouden estin alla stoicheis kai autos ton nomon phulasson
peri de ton pepisteukoton ethnon hemeis epesteilamen krinantes meden toiouton terein autous ei me phulassesthai autous to te eidolothuton kai to haima kai pnikton kai porneian

tote ho paulos paralabon tous andras te echomene hemera sun autois hagnistheis eiseei eis to hieron dianellon ten ekplerosin ton hemeron tou hagnismou heos hou prosenechthe huper henos hekastou auton he prosphora
hos de emellon hai hepta hemerai sunteleisthai hoi apo tes asias ioudaioi theasamenoi auton en to hiero sunecheon panta ton ochlon kai epebalon tas cheiras ep auton

krazontes andres israelitai boetheite houtos estin ho anthropos ho kata tou laou kai tou nomou kai tou topou toutou pantas pantachou didaskon eti te kai hellenas eisegagen eis to hieron kai kekoinoken ton hagion topon touton
esan gar proeorakotes trophimon ton ephesion en te polei sun auto hon enomizon hoti eis to hieron eisegagen ho paulos
ekinethe te he polis hole kai egeneto sundrome tou laou kai epilabomenoi tou paulou heilkon auton exo tou hierou kai eutheos ekleisthesan hai thurai
zetounton de auton apokteinai anebe phasis to chiliarcho tes speires hoti hole sunkechutai ierousalem
hos exautes paralabon stratiotas kai hekatontarchous katedramen ep autous hoi de idontes ton chiliarchon kai tous stratiotas epausanto tuptontes ton paulon
tote enisas ho chiliarchos epelabeto autou kai ekeleusen dethenai halusesin dusin kai epunthaneto tis an eie kai ti estin pepoiekos
alloi de allo ti eboon en to ochlo me dunamenos de gnonai to asphales dia ton thorubon ekeleusen agesthai auton eis ten parembolen
hote de egeneto epi tous anabathmous sunebe bastazesthai auton hupo ton stratioton dia ten bian tou ochlou
ekolouthei gar to plethos tou laou krazon aire auton
mellon te eisagesthai eis ten parembolen ho paulos legei to chiliarcho ei exestin moi eipein ti pros se ho de ephe hellenisti ginoskeis
ouk ara su ei ho aiguptios ho pro touton ton hemeron anastatosas kai exagagon eis ten eremon tous tetrakischilious andras ton sikarion
eipen de ho paulos ego anthropos men eimi ioudaios tarseus tes kilikias ouk asemou poleos polites deomai de sou epitrepson moi lalesai pros ton laon
epitrepsantos de autou ho paulos hestos epi ton anabathmon kateseisen te cheiri to lao polles de siges genomenes prosephonesen te hebraidi dialekto legon
andres adelphoi kai pateres akousate mou tes pros humas nun apologias
akousantes de hoti te hebraidi dialekto prosephonei autois mallon pareschon hesuchian kai phesin

ego men eimi aner ioudaios gegennemenos en tarso tes kilikias anatethrammenos de en te polei taute para tous podas gamaliel pepaideumenos kata akribeian tou patroou nomou zelotes huparchon tou theou kathos pantes humeis este semeron
hos tauten ten hodon edioxa achri thanatou desmeuon kai paradidous eis phulakas andras te kai gunaikas

hos kai ho archiereus marturei moi kai pan to presbuterion par hon kai epistolas dexamenos pros tous adelphous eis damaskon eporeuomen axon kai tous ekeise ontas dedemenous eis ierousalem hina timorethosin
egeneto de moi poreuomeno kai enizonti te damasko peri mesembrian exaiphnes ek tou ouranou periastrapsai phos hikanon peri eme
epeson te eis to edaphos kai ekousa phones legouses moi saoul saoul ti me diokeis
ego de apekrithen tis ei kurie eipen te pros me ego eimi iesous ho nazoraios hon su diokeis
hoi de sun emoi ontes to men phos etheasanto kai emphoboi egenonto ten de phonen ouk ekousan tou lalountos moi
eipon de ti poieso kurie ho de kurios eipen pros me anastas poreuou eis damaskon kakei soi lalethesetai peri panton hon tetaktai soi poiesai
hos de ouk eneblepon apo tes doxes tou photos ekeinou cheiragogoumenos hupo ton sunonton moi elthon eis damaskon
hananias de tis aner eusebes kata ton nomon marturoumenos hupo panton ton katoikounton ioudaion
elthon pros me kai epistas eipen moi saoul adelphe anablepson kago aute te hora aneblepsa eis auton
ho de eipen ho theos ton pateron hemon proecheirisato se gnonai to thelema autou kai idein ton dikaion kai akousai phonen ek tou stomatos autou
hoti ese martus auto pros pantas anthropous hon heorakas kai ekousas
kai nun ti melleis anastas baptisai kai apolousai tas hamartias sou epikalesamenos to onoma tou kuriou
egeneto de moi hupostrepsanti eis ierousalem kai proseuchomenou mou en to hiero genesthai me en ekstasei
kai idein auton legonta moi speuson kai exelthe en tachei ex ierousalem dioti ou paradexontai sou ten marturian peri emou
kago eipon kurie autoi epistantai hoti ego emen phulakizon kai deron kata tas sunagogas tous pisteuontas epi se
kai hote execheito to haima stephanou tou marturos sou kai autos emen ephestos kai suneudokon te anairesei autou kai phulasson ta himatia ton anairounton auton
kai eipen pros me poreuou hoti ego eis ethne makran exapostelo se
ekouon de autou achri toutou tou logou kai eperan ten phonen auton legontes aire apo tes ges ton toiouton ou gar kathekon auton zen
kraugazonton de auton kai hriptounton ta himatia kai koniorton ballonton eis ton aera
ekeleusen auton ho chiliarchos agesthai eis ten parembolen eipon mastixin anetazesthai auton hina epigno di hen aitian houtos epephonoun auto
hos de proeteinen auton tois himasin eipen pros ton hestota hekatontarchon ho paulos ei anthropon hromaion kai akatakriton exestin humin mastizein
akousas de ho hekatontarchos proselthon apeneilen to chiliarcho legon hora ti melleis poiein ho gar anthropos houtos hromaios estin
proselthon de ho chiliarchos eipen auto lege moi ei su hromaios ei ho de ephe nai
apekrithe te ho chiliarchos ego pollou kephalaiou ten politeian tauten ektesamen ho de paulos ephe ego de kai gegennemai
eutheos oun apestesan ap autou hoi mellontes auton anetazein kai ho chiliarchos de ephobethe epignous hoti hromaios estin kai hoti en auton dedekos

te de epaurion boulomenos gnonai to asphales to ti kategoreitai para ton ioudaion elusen auton apo ton desmon kai ekeleusen elthein tous archiereis kai holon to sunedrion auton kai katagagon ton paulon estesen eis autous
atenisas de ho paulos to sunedrio eipen andres adelphoi ego pase suneidesei agathe pepoliteumai to theo achri tautes tes hemeras
ho de archiereus hananias epetaxen tois parestosin auto tuptein autou to stoma
tote ho paulos pros auton eipen tuptein se mellei ho theos toiche kekoniamene kai su kathe krinon me kata ton nomon kai paranomon keleueis me tuptesthai
hoi de parestotes eipon ton archierea tou theou loidoreis
ephe te ho paulos ouk edein adelphoi hoti estin archiereus gegraptai gar archonta tou laou sou ouk ereis kakos

gnous de ho paulos hoti to hen meros estin saddoukaion to de heteron pharisaion ekraxen en to sunedrio andres adelphoi ego pharisaios eimi huios pharisaiou peri elpidos kai anastaseos nekron ego krinomai
touto de autou lalesantos egeneto stasis ton pharisaion kai ton saddoukaion kai eschisthe to plethos
saddoukaioi men gar legousin me einai anastasin mede anelon mete pneuma pharisaioi de homologousin ta amphotera
egeneto de krauge megale kai anastantes hoi grammateis tou merous ton pharisaion diemachonto legontes ouden kakon heuriskomen en to anthropo touto ei de pneuma elalesen auto e anelos me theomachomen
polles de genomenes staseos eulabetheis ho chiliarchos me diaspasthe ho paulos hup auton ekeleusen to strateuma kataban harpasai auton ek mesou auton agein te eis ten parembolen
te de epiouse nukti epistas auto ho kurios eipen tharsei paule hos gar diemarturo ta peri emou eis ierousalem houtos se dei kai eis hromen marturesai
genomenes de hemeras poiesantes tines ton ioudaion sustrophen anethematisan heautous legontes mete phagein mete piein heos hou apokteinosin ton paulon
esan de pleious tessarakonta hoi tauten ten sunomosian pepoiekotes
hoitines proselthontes tois archiereusin kai tois presbuterois eipon anathemati anethematisamen heautous medenos geusasthai heos hou apokteinomen ton paulon

nun oun humeis emphanisate to chiliarcho sun to sunedrio hopos aurion auton katagage pros humas hos mellontas diaginoskein akribesteron ta peri autou hemeis de pro tou enisai auton hetoimoi esmen tou anelein auton
akousas de ho huios tes adelphes paulou to enedron paragenomenos kai eiselthon eis ten parembolen apeneilen to paulo
proskalesamenos de ho paulos hena ton hekatontarchon ephe ton neanian touton apagage pros ton chiliarchon echei gar ti apaneilai auto
ho men oun paralabon auton egagen pros ton chiliarchon kai phesin ho desmios paulos proskalesamenos me erotesen touton ton neanian agagein pros se echonta ti lalesai soi
epilabomenos de tes cheiros autou ho chiliarchos kai anachoresas kat idian epunthaneto ti estin ho echeis apaneilai moi
eipen de hoti hoi ioudaioi sunethento tou erotesai se hopos aurion eis to sunedrion katagages ton paulon hos mellontes ti akribesteron punthanesthai peri autou

su oun me peisthes autois enedreuousin gar auton ex auton andres pleious tessarakonta hoitines anethematisan heautous mete phagein mete piein heos hou anelosin auton kai nun hetoimoi eisin prosdechomenoi ten apo sou epanelian
ho men oun chiliarchos apelusen ton neanian paraneilas medeni eklalesai hoti tauta enephanisas pros me

kai proskalesamenos duo tinas ton hekatontarchon eipen hetoimasate stratiotas diakosious hopos poreuthosin heos kaisareias kai hippeis hebdomekonta kai dexiolabous diakosious apo trites horas tes nuktos
ktene te parastesai hina epibibasantes ton paulon diasososin pros phelika ton hegemona
grapsas epistolen periechousan ton tupon touton
klaudios lusias to kratisto hegemoni pheliki chairein
ton andra touton sullephthenta hupo ton ioudaion kai mellonta anaireisthai hup auton epistas sun to strateumati exeilomen auton mathon hoti hromaios estin
boulomenos de gnonai ten aitian di hen enekaloun auto kategagon auton eis to sunedrion auton
hon heuron enkaloumenon peri zetematon tou nomou auton meden de axion thanatou e desmon enklema echonta
menutheises de moi epiboules eis ton andra mellein esesthai hupo ton ioudaion exautes epempsa pros se paraneilas kai tois kategorois legein ta pros auton epi sou erroso
hoi men oun stratiotai kata to diatetagmenon autois analabontes ton paulon egagon dia tes nuktos eis ten antipatrida
te de epaurion easantes tous hippeis poreuesthai sun auto hupestrepsan eis ten parembolen
hoitines eiselthontes eis ten kaisareian kai anadontes ten epistolen to hegemoni parestesan kai ton paulon auto
anagnous de ho hegemon kai eperotesas ek poias eparchias estin kai puthomenos hoti apo kilikias
diakousomai sou ephe hotan kai hoi kategoroi sou paragenontai ekeleusen te auton en to praitorio tou herodou phulassesthai
meta de pente hemeras katebe ho archiereus hananias meta ton presbuteron kai hretoros tertullou tinos hoitines enephanisan to hegemoni kata tou paulou
klethentos de autou erxato kategorein ho tertullos legon polles eirenes tunchanontes dia sou kai katorthomaton ginomenon to ethnei touto dia tes ses pronoias
pante te kai pantachou apodechometha kratiste phelix meta pases eucharistias
hina de me epi pleion se enkopto parakalo akousai se hemon suntomos te se epieikeia
heurontes gar ton andra touton loimon kai kinounta stasin pasin tois ioudaiois tois kata ten oikoumenen protostaten te tes ton nazoraion haireseos
hos kai to hieron epeirasen bebelosai hon kai ekratesamen kai kata ton hemeteron nomon ethelesamen krinein
parelthon de lusias ho chiliarchos meta polles bias ek ton cheiron hemon apegagen
keleusas tous kategorous autou erchesthai epi se par hou dunese autos anakrinas peri panton touton epignonai hon hemeis kategoroumen autou
sunethento de kai hoi ioudaioi phaskontes tauta houtos echein
apekrithe de ho paulos neusantos auto tou hegemonos legein ek pollon eton onta se kriten to ethnei touto epistamenos euthumoteron ta peri emautou apologoumai
dunamenou sou gnonai hoti ou pleious eisin moi hemerai e dekaduo aph hes aneben proskuneson en ierousalem
kai oute en to hiero heuron me pros tina dialegomenon e episustasin poiounta ochlou oute en tais sunagogais oute kata ten polin
oute parastesai me dunantai peri hon nun kategorousin mou
homologo de touto soi hoti kata ten hodon hen legousin hairesin houtos latreuo to patroo theo pisteuon pasin tois kata ton nomon kai tois prophetais gegrammenois
elpida echon eis ton theon hen kai autoi houtoi prosdechontai anastasin mellein esesthai nekron dikaion te kai adikon
en touto de autos asko aproskopon suneidesin echein pros ton theon kai tous anthropous diapantos
di eton de pleionon paregenomen eleemosunas poieson eis to ethnos mou kai prosphoras
en hois heuron me hegnismenon en to hiero ou meta ochlou oude meta thorubou tines de apo tes asias ioudaioi
hous dei epi sou pareinai kai kategorein ei ti echoien pros me
e autoi houtoi eipatosan ei ti heuron en emoi adikema stantos mou epi tou sunedriou
e peri mias tautes phones hes ekraxa hestos en autois hoti peri anastaseos nekron ego krinomai semeron huph humon
akousas de tauta ho phelix anebaleto autous akribesteron eidos ta peri tes hodou eipon hotan lusias ho chiliarchos katabe diagnosomai ta kath humas
diataxamenos te to hekatontarche tereisthai ton paulon echein te anesin kai medena koluein ton idion autou huperetein e proserchesthai auto
meta de hemeras tinas paragenomenos ho phelix sun drousille te gunaiki autou ouse ioudaia metepempsato ton paulon kai ekousen autou peri tes eis christon pisteos
dialegomenou de autou peri dikaiosunes kai enkrateias kai tou krimatos tou mellontos esesthai emphobos genomenos ho phelix apekrithe to nun echon poreuou kairon de metalabon metakalesomai se
hama de kai elpizon hoti chremata dothesetai auto hupo tou paulou hopos luse auton dio kai puknoteron auton metapempomenos homilei auto
dietias de plerotheises elaben diadochon ho phelix porkion pheston thelon te charitas katathesthai tois ioudaiois ho phelix katelipen ton paulon dedemenon
phestos oun epibas te eparchia meta treis hemeras anebe eis hierosoluma apo kaisareias
enephanisan de auto ho archiereus kai hoi protoi ton ioudaion kata tou paulou kai parekaloun auton
aitoumenoi charin kat autou hopos metapempsetai auton eis ierousalem enedran poiountes anelein auton kata ten hodon
ho men oun phestos apekrithe tereisthai ton paulon en kaisareia heauton de mellein en tachei ekporeuesthai
hoi oun dunatoi en humin phesin sunkatabantes ei ti estin en to andri touto kategoreitosan autou
diatripsas de en autois hemeras pleious e deka katabas eis kaisareian te epaurion kathisas epi tou bematos ekeleusen ton paulon achthenai
paragenomenou de autou periestesan hoi apo hierosolumon katabebekotes ioudaioi polla kai barea aitiamata pherontes kata tou paulou ha ouk ischuon apodeixai
apologoumenou autou hoti oute eis ton nomon ton ioudaion oute eis to hieron oute eis kaisara ti hemarton
ho phestos de tois ioudaiois thelon charin katathesthai apokritheis to paulo eipen theleis eis hierosoluma anabas ekei peri touton krinesthai ep emou
eipen de ho paulos epi tou bematos kaisaros hestos eimi hou me dei krinesthai ioudaious ouden edikesa hos kai su kallion epiginoskeis
ei men gar adiko kai axion thanatou pepracha ti ou paraitoumai to apothanein ei de ouden estin hon houtoi kategorousin mou oudeis me dunatai autois charisasthai kaisara epikaloumai
tote ho phestos sullalesas meta tou sumbouliou apekrithe kaisara epikeklesai epi kaisara poreuse
hemeron de diagenomenon tinon agrippas ho basileus kai bernike katentesan eis kaisareian aspasomenoi ton pheston
hos de pleious hemeras dietribon ekei ho phestos to basilei anetheto ta kata ton paulon legon aner tis estin kataleleimmenos hupo phelikos desmios
peri hou genomenou mou eis hierosoluma enephanisan hoi archiereis kai hoi presbuteroi ton ioudaion aitoumenoi kat autou diken
pros hous apekrithen hoti ouk estin ethos hromaiois charizesthai tina anthropon eis apoleian prin e ho kategoroumenos kata prosopon echoi tous kategorous topon te apologias laboi peri tou enklematos
sunelthonton oun auton enthade anabolen medemian poiesamenos te hexes kathisas epi tou bematos ekeleusa achthenai ton andra
peri hou stathentes hoi kategoroi oudemian aitian epepheron hon hupenooun ego
zetemata de tina peri tes idias deisidaimonias eichon pros auton kai peri tinos iesou tethnekotos hon ephasken ho paulos zen
aporoumenos de ego eis ten peri toutou zetesin elegon ei bouloito poreuesthai eis ierousalem kakei krinesthai peri touton
tou de paulou epikalesamenou terethenai auton eis ten tou sebastou diagnosin ekeleusa tereisthai auton heos hou pempso auton pros kaisara
agrippas de pros ton pheston ephe eboulomen kai autos tou anthropou akousai ho de aurion phesin akouse autou

te oun epaurion elthontos tou agrippa kai tes bernikes meta polles phantasias kai eiselthonton eis to akroaterion sun te tois chiliarchois kai andrasin tois kat exochen ousin tes poleos kai keleusantos tou phestou echthe ho paulos

kai phesin ho phestos agrippa basileu kai pantes hoi sumparontes hemin andres theoreite touton peri hou pan to plethos ton ioudaion enetuchon moi en te hierosolumois kai enthade epiboontes me dein zen auton meketi
ego de katalabomenos meden axion thanatou auton peprachenai kai autou de toutou epikalesamenou ton sebaston ekrina pempein auton
peri hou asphales ti grapsai to kurio ouk echo dio proegagon auton eph humon kai malista epi sou basileu agrippa hopos tes anakriseos genomenes scho ti grapsai
alogon gar moi dokei pemponta desmion me kai tas kat autou aitias semanai
agrippas de pros ton paulon ephe epitrepetai soi huper seautou legein tote ho paulos apelogeito ekteinas ten cheira
peri panton hon enkaloumai hupo ioudaion basileu agrippa hegemai emauton makarion mellon apologeisthai epi sou semeron
malista gnosten onta se panton ton kata ioudaious ethon te kai zetematon dio deomai sou makrothumos akousai mou
ten men oun biosin mou ten ek neotetos ten ap arches genomenen en to ethnei mou en hierosolumois isasin pantes hoi ioudaioi
proginoskontes me anothen ean thelosin marturein hoti kata ten akribestaten hairesin tes hemeteras threskeias ezesa pharisaios
kai nun ep elpidi tes pros tous pateras epanelias genomenes hupo tou theou hesteka krinomenos
eis hen to dodekaphulon hemon en ekteneia nukta kai hemeran latreuon elpizei katantesai peri hes elpidos enkaloumai basileu agrippa hupo ton ioudaion
ti apiston krinetai par humin ei ho theos nekrous egeirei
ego men oun edoxa emauto pros to onoma iesou tou nazoraiou dein polla enantia praxai
ho kai epoiesa en hierosolumois kai pollous ton hagion ego phulakais katekleisa ten para ton archiereon exousian labon anairoumenon te auton katenenka psephon
kai kata pasas tas sunagogas pollakis timoron autous enankazon blasphemein perissos te emmainomenos autois ediokon heos kai eis tas exo poleis
en hois kai poreuomenos eis ten damaskon met exousias kai epitropes tes para ton archiereon
hemeras meses kata ten hodon eidon basileu ouranothen huper ten lamproteta tou heliou perilampsan me phos kai tous sun emoi poreuomenous
panton de katapesonton hemon eis ten gen ekousa phonen lalousan pros me kai legousan te hebraidi dialekto saoul saoul ti me diokeis skleron soi pros kentra laktizein

ei oun eme echeis koinonon proslabou auton hos eme
ei de ti edikesen se e opheilei touto emoi ellogei
ego paulos egrapsa te eme cheiri ego apotiso hina me lego soi hoti kai seauton moi prosopheileis
nai adelphe ego sou onaimen en kurio anapauson mou ta splanchna en kurio
pepoithos te hupakoe sou egrapsa soi eidos hoti kai huper ho lego poieseis
hama de kai hetoimaze moi xenian elpizo gar hoti dia ton proseuchon humon charisthesomai humin
aspazontai se epaphras ho sunaichmalotos mou en christo iesou
markos aristarchos demas loukas hoi sunergoi mou
he charis tou kuriou hemon iesou christou meta tou pneumatos humon amen
Hebrews: polumeros kai polutropos palai ho theos lalesas tois patrasin en tois prophetais
ep eschaton ton hemeron touton elalesen hemin en huio hon etheken kleronomon panton di hou kai tous aionas epoiesen

hos on apaugasma tes doxes kai charakter tes hupostaseos autou pheron te ta panta to hremati tes dunameos autou di heautou katharismon poiesamenos ton hamartion hemon ekathisen en dexia tes megalosunes en hupselois
tosouto kreitton genomenos ton anelon hoso diaphoroteron par autous kekleronomeken onoma
tini gar eipen pote ton anelon huios mou ei su ego semeron gegenneka se kai palin ego esomai auto eis patera kai autos estai moi eis huion
hotan de palin eisagage ton prototokon eis ten oikoumenen legei kai proskunesatosan auto pantes aneloi theou
kai pros men tous anelous legei ho poion tous anelous autou pneumata kai tous leitourgous autou puros phloga
pros de ton huion ho thronos sou ho theos eis ton aiona tou aionos hrabdos euthutetos he hrabdos tes basileias sou
egapesas dikaiosunen kai emisesas anomian dia touto echrisen se ho theos ho theos sou elaion agalliaseos para tous metochous sou
kai su kat archas kurie ten gen ethemeliosas kai erga ton cheiron sou eisin hoi ouranoi
autoi apolountai su de diameneis kai pantes hos himation palaiothesontai
kai hosei peribolaion helixeis autous kai allagesontai su de ho autos ei kai ta ete sou ouk ekleipsousin
pros tina de ton anelon eireken pote kathou ek dexion mou heos an tho tous echthrous sou hupopodion ton podon sou
ouchi pantes eisin leitourgika pneumata eis diakonian apostellomena dia tous mellontas kleronomein soterian
dia touto dei perissoteros hemas prosechein tois akoustheisin mepote pararruomen
ei gar ho di anelon laletheis logos egeneto bebaios kai pasa parabasis kai parakoe elaben endikon misthapodosian
pos hemeis ekpheuxometha telikautes amelesantes soterias hetis archen labousa laleisthai dia tou kuriou hupo ton akousanton eis hemas ebebaiothe
sunepimarturountos tou theou semeiois te kai terasin kai poikilais dunamesin kai pneumatos hagiou merismois kata ten autou thelesin
ou gar anelois hupetaxen ten oikoumenen ten mellousan peri hes laloumen
diemarturato de pou tis legon ti estin anthropos hoti mimneske autou e huios anthropou hoti episkepte auton
elattosas auton brachu ti par anelous doxe kai time estephanosas auton kai katestesas auton epi ta erga ton cheiron sou
panta hupetaxas hupokato ton podon autou en gar to hupotaxai auto ta panta ouden apheken auto anupotakton nun de oupo horomen auto ta panta hupotetagmena
ton de brachu ti par anelous elattomenon blepomen iesoun dia to pathema tou thanatou doxe kai time estephanomenon hopos chariti theou huper pantos geusetai thanatou
eprepen gar auto di hon ta panta kai di hou ta panta pollous huious eis doxan agagonta ton archegon tes soterias auton dia pathematon teleiosai
ho te gar hagiazon kai hoi hagiazomenoi ex henos pantes di hen aitian ouk epaischunetai adelphous autous kalein
legon apanelo to onoma sou tois adelphois mou en meso ekklesias humneso se
kai palin ego esomai pepoithos ep auto kai palin idou ego kai ta paidia ha moi edoken ho theos
epei oun ta paidia kekoinoneken sarkos kai haimatos kai autos paraplesios meteschen ton auton hina dia tou thanatou katargese ton to kratos echonta tou thanatou tout estin ton diabolon
kai apallaxe toutous hosoi phobo thanatou dia pantos tou zen enochoi esan douleias
ou gar depou anelon epilambanetai alla spermatos abraam epilambanetai
hothen opheilen kata panta tois adelphois homoiothenai hina eleemon genetai kai pistos archiereus ta pros ton theon eis to hilaskesthai tas hamartias tou laou
en ho gar peponthen autos peirastheis dunatai tois peirazomenois boethesai
hothen adelphoi hagioi kleseos epouraniou metochoi katanoesate ton apostolon kai archierea tes homologias hemon christon iesoun
piston onta to poiesanti auton hos kai moses en holo to oiko autou
pleionos gar doxes houtos para mosen exiotai kath hoson pleiona timen echei tou oikou ho kataskeuasas auton
pas gar oikos kataskeuazetai hupo tinos ho de ta panta kataskeuasas theos
kai moses men pistos en holo to oiko autou hos therapon eis marturion ton lalethesomenon
christos de hos huios epi ton oikon autou hou oikos esmen hemeis eanper ten parresian kai to kauchema tes elpidos mechri telous bebaian kataschomen
dio kathos legei to pneuma to hagion semeron ean tes phones autou akousete
me sklerunete tas kardias humon hos en to parapikrasmo kata ten hemeran tou peirasmou en te eremo
hou epeirasan me hoi pateres humon edokimasan me kai eidon ta erga mou tessarakonta ete
dio prosochthisa te genea ekeine kai eipon aei planontai te kardia autoi de ouk egnosan tas hodous mou
hos omosa en te orge mou ei eiseleusontai eis ten katapausin mou
blepete adelphoi mepote estai en tini humon kardia ponera apistias en to apostenai apo theou zontos
alla parakaleite heautous kath hekasten hemeran achris hou to semeron kaleitai hina me sklerunthe tis ex humon apate tes hamartias
metochoi gar gegonamen tou christou eanper ten archen tes hupostaseos mechri telous bebaian kataschomen
en to legesthai semeron ean tes phones autou akousete me sklerunete tas kardias humon hos en to parapikrasmo
tines gar akousantes parepikranan all ou pantes hoi exelthontes ex aiguptou dia moseos
tisin de prosochthisen tessarakonta ete ouchi tois hamartesasin hon ta kola epesen en te eremo
tisin de omosen me eiseleusesthai eis ten katapausin autou ei me tois apeithesasin
kai blepomen hoti ouk edunethesan eiselthein di apistian
phobethomen oun mepote kataleipomenes epanelias eiselthein eis ten katapausin autou doke tis ex humon husterekenai
kai gar esmen euenelismenoi kathaper kakeinoi all ouk ophelesen ho logos tes akoes ekeinous me sunkekramenos te pistei tois akousasin
eiserchometha gar eis ten katapausin hoi pisteusantes kathos eireken hos omosa en te orge mou ei eiseleusontai eis ten katapausin mou kaitoi ton ergon apo kataboles kosmou genethenton
eireken gar pou peri tes hebdomes houtos kai katepausen ho theos en te hemera te hebdome apo panton ton ergon autou
kai en touto palin ei eiseleusontai eis ten katapausin mou
epei oun apoleipetai tinas eiselthein eis auten kai hoi proteron euanelisthentes ouk eiselthon di apeitheian
palin tina horizei hemeran semeron en dabid legon meta tosouton chronon kathos eiretai semeron ean tes phones autou akousete me sklerunete tas kardias humon
ei gar autous iesous katepausen ouk an peri alles elalei meta tauta hemeras
ara apoleipetai sabbatismos to lao tou theou
ho gar eiselthon eis ten katapausin autou kai autos katepausen apo ton ergon autou hosper apo ton idion ho theos
spoudasomen oun eiselthein eis ekeinen ten katapausin hina me en to auto tis hupodeigmati pese tes apeitheias

zon gar ho logos tou theou kai energes kai tomoteros huper pasan machairan distomon kai diiknoumenos achri merismou psuches te kai pneumatos harmon te kai muelon kai kritikos enthumeseon kai ennoion kardias
kai ouk estin ktisis aphanes enopion autou panta de gumna kai tetrachelismena tois ophthalmois autou pros hon hemin ho logos
echontes oun archierea megan dieleluthota tous ouranous iesoun ton huion tou theou kratomen tes homologias
ou gar echomen archierea me dunamenon sumpathesai tais astheneiais hemon pepeiramenon de kata panta kath homoioteta choris hamartias
proserchometha oun meta parresias to throno tes charitos hina labomen eleon kai charin heuromen eis eukairon boetheian
pas gar archiereus ex anthropon lambanomenos huper anthropon kathistatai ta pros ton theon hina prosphere dora te kai thusias huper hamartion
metriopathein dunamenos tois agnoousin kai planomenois epei kai autos perikeitai astheneian
kai dia tauten opheilei kathos peri tou laou houtos kai peri heautou prospherein huper hamartion
kai ouch heauto tis lambanei ten timen alla ho kaloumenos hupo tou theou kathaper kai ho aaron
houtos kai ho christos ouch heauton edoxasen genethenai archierea all ho lalesas pros auton huios mou ei su ego semeron gegenneka se
kathos kai en hetero legei su hiereus eis ton aiona kata ten taxin melchisedek
hos en tais hemerais tes sarkos autou deeseis te kai hiketerias pros ton dunamenon sozein auton ek thanatou meta krauges ischuras kai dakruon prosenenkas kai eisakoustheis apo tes eulabeias
kaiper on huios emathen aph hon epathen ten hupakoen
kai teleiotheis egeneto tois hupakouousin auto pasin aitios soterias aioniou
prosagoreutheis hupo tou theou archiereus kata ten taxin melchisedek
peri hou polus hemin ho logos kai dusermeneutos legein epei nothroi gegonate tais akoais

kai gar opheilontes einai didaskaloi dia ton chronon palin chreian echete tou didaskein humas tina ta stoicheia tes arches ton logion tou theou kai gegonate chreian echontes galaktos kai ou stereas trophes
pas gar ho metechon galaktos apeiros logou dikaiosunes nepios gar estin
teleion de estin he sterea trophe ton dia ten hexin ta aistheteria gegumnasmena echonton pros diakrisin kalou te kai kakou
dio aphentes ton tes arches tou christou logon epi ten teleioteta pherometha me palin themelion kataballomenoi metanoias apo nekron ergon kai pisteos epi theon
baptismon didaches epitheseos te cheiron anastaseos te nekron kai krimatos aioniou
kai touto poiesomen eanper epitrepe ho theos
adunaton gar tous hapax photisthentas geusamenous te tes doreas tes epouraniou kai metochous genethentas pneumatos hagiou
kai kalon geusamenous theou hrema dunameis te mellontos aionos
kai parapesontas palin anakainizein eis metanoian anastaurountas heautois ton huion tou theou kai paradeigmatizontas
ge gar he piousa ton ep autes pollakis erchomenon hueton kai tiktousa botanen eutheton ekeinois di hous kai georgeitai metalambanei eulogias apo tou theou
ekpherousa de akanthas kai tribolous adokimos kai kataras enus hes to telos eis kausin
pepeismetha de peri humon agapetoi ta kreittona kai echomena soterias ei kai houtos laloumen
ou gar adikos ho theos epilathesthai tou ergou humon kai tou kopou tes agapes hes enedeixasthe eis to onoma autou diakonesantes tois hagiois kai diakonountes
epithumoumen de hekaston humon ten auten endeiknusthai spouden pros ten plerophorian tes elpidos achri telous
hina me nothroi genesthe mimetai de ton dia pisteos kai makrothumias kleronomounton tas epanelias
to gar abraam epaneilamenos ho theos epei kat oudenos eichen meizonos omosai omosen kath heautou
legon e men eulogon eulogeso se kai plethunon plethuno se
kai houtos makrothumesas epetuchen tes epanelias
anthropoi men gar kata tou meizonos omnuousin kai pases autois antilogias peras eis bebaiosin ho horkos
en ho perissoteron boulomenos ho theos epideixai tois kleronomois tes epanelias to ametatheton tes boules autou emesiteusen horko
hina dia duo pragmaton ametatheton en hois adunaton pseusasthai theon ischuran paraklesin echomen hoi kataphugontes kratesai tes prokeimenes elpidos
hen hos ankuran echomen tes psuches asphale te kai bebaian kai eiserchomenen eis to esoteron tou katapetasmatos
hopou prodromos huper hemon eiselthen iesous kata ten taxin melchisedek archiereus genomenos eis ton aiona
houtos gar ho melchisedek basileus salem hiereus tou theou tou hupsistou ho sunantesas abraam hupostrephonti apo tes kopes ton basileon kai eulogesas auton
ho kai dekaten apo panton emerisen abraam proton men hermeneuomenos basileus dikaiosunes epeita de kai basileus salem ho estin basileus eirenes
apator ametor agenealogetos mete archen hemeron mete zoes telos echon aphomoiomenos de to huio tou theou menei hiereus eis to dienekes
theoreite de pelikos houtos ho kai dekaten abraam edoken ek ton akrothinion ho patriarches
kai hoi men ek ton huion leui ten hierateian lambanontes entolen echousin apodekatoun ton laon kata ton nomon tout estin tous adelphous auton kaiper exeleluthotas ek tes osphuos abraam
ho de me genealogoumenos ex auton dedekatoken ton abraam kai ton echonta tas epanelias eulogeken
choris de pases antilogias to elatton hupo tou kreittonos eulogeitai
kai hode men dekatas apothneskontes anthropoi lambanousin ekei de marturoumenos hoti ze
kai hos epos eipein dia abraam kai leui ho dekatas lambanon dedekatotai
eti gar en te osphui tou patros en hote sunentesen auto ho melchisedek
ei men oun teleiosis dia tes leuitikes hierosunes en ho laos gar ep aute nenomotheteto tis eti chreia kata ten taxin melchisedek heteron anistasthai hierea kai ou kata ten taxin aaron legesthai
metatithemenes gar tes hierosunes ex anankes kai nomou metathesis ginetai
eph hon gar legetai tauta phules heteras metescheken aph hes oudeis prosescheken to thusiasterio
prodelon gar hoti ex iouda anatetalken ho kurios hemon eis hen phulen ouden peri hierosunes moses elalesen
kai perissoteron eti katadelon estin ei kata ten homoioteta melchisedek anistatai hiereus heteros
hos ou kata nomon entoles sarkikes gegonen alla kata dunamin zoes akatalutou
marturei gar hoti su hiereus eis ton aiona kata ten taxin melchisedek
athetesis men gar ginetai proagouses entoles dia to autes asthenes kai anopheles
ouden gar eteleiosen ho nomos epeisagoge de kreittonos elpidos di hes enizomen to theo
kai kath hoson ou choris horkomosias
hoi men gar choris horkomosias eisin hiereis gegonotes ho de meta horkomosias dia tou legontos pros auton omosen kurios kai ou metamelethesetai su hiereus eis ton aiona kata ten taxin melchisedek
kata tosouton kreittonos diathekes gegonen enuos iesous
kai hoi men pleiones eisin gegonotes hiereis dia to thanato koluesthai paramenein
ho de dia to menein auton eis ton aiona aparabaton echei ten hierosunen
hothen kai sozein eis to panteles dunatai tous proserchomenous di autou to theo pantote zon eis to entunchanein huper auton
toioutos gar hemin eprepen archiereus hosios akakos amiantos kechorismenos apo ton hamartolon kai hupseloteros ton ouranon genomenos
hos ouk echei kath hemeran ananken hosper hoi archiereis proteron huper ton idion hamartion thusias anapherein epeita ton tou laou touto gar epoiesen ephapax heauton anenenkas
ho nomos gar anthropous kathistesin archiereis echontas astheneian ho logos de tes horkomosias tes meta ton nomon huion eis ton aiona teteleiomenon
kephalaion de epi tois legomenois toiouton echomen archierea hos ekathisen en dexia tou thronou tes megalosunes en tois ouranois
ton hagion leitourgos kai tes skenes tes alethines hen epexen ho kurios kai ouk anthropos
pas gar archiereus eis to prospherein dora te kai thusias kathistatai hothen anankaion echein ti kai touton ho prosenenke
ei men gar en epi ges oud an en hiereus onton ton hiereon ton prospheronton kata ton nomon ta dora
hoitines hupodeigmati kai skia latreuousin ton epouranion kathos kechrematistai moses mellon epitelein ten skenen hora gar phesin poieses panta kata ton tupon ton deichthenta soi en to orei
nuni de diaphoroteras teteuchen leitourgias hoso kai kreittonos estin diathekes mesites hetis epi kreittosin epaneliais nenomothetetai
ei gar he prote ekeine en amemptos ouk an deuteras ezeteito topos
memphomenos gar autois legei idou hemerai erchontai legei kurios kai sunteleso epi ton oikon israel kai epi ton oikon iouda diatheken kainen

ou kata ten diatheken hen epoiesa tois patrasin auton en hemera epilabomenou mou tes cheiros auton exagagein autous ek ges aiguptou hoti autoi ouk enemeinan en te diatheke mou kago emelesa auton legei kurios

hoti haute he diatheke hen diathesomai to oiko israel meta tas hemeras ekeinas legei kurios didous nomous mou eis ten dianoian auton kai epi kardias auton epigrapso autous kai esomai autois eis theon kai autoi esontai moi eis laon
kai ou me didaxosin hekastos ton plesion autou kai hekastos ton adelphon autou legon gnothi ton kurion hoti pantes eidesousin me apo mikrou auton heos megalou auton
hoti hileos esomai tais adikiais auton kai ton hamartion auton kai ton anomion auton ou me mnestho eti
en to legein kainen pepalaioken ten proten to de palaioumenon kai geraskon enus aphanismou
eichen men oun kai he prote skene dikaiomata latreias to te hagion kosmikon
skene gar kateskeuasthe he prote en he he te luchnia kai he trapeza kai he prothesis ton arton hetis legetai hagia
meta de to deuteron katapetasma skene he legomene hagia hagion
chrusoun echousa thumiaterion kai ten kiboton tes diathekes perikekalummenen pantothen chrusio en he stamnos chruse echousa to manna kai he hrabdos aaron he blastesasa kai hai plakes tes diathekes
huperano de autes cheroubim doxes kataskiazonta to hilasterion peri hon ouk estin nun legein kata meros
touton de houtos kateskeuasmenon eis men ten proten skenen diapantos eisiasin hoi hiereis tas latreias epitelountes
eis de ten deuteran hapax tou eniautou monos ho archiereus ou choris haimatos ho prospherei huper heautou kai ton tou laou agnoematon
touto delountos tou pneumatos tou hagiou mepo pephanerosthai ten ton hagion hodon eti tes protes skenes echouses stasin
hetis parabole eis ton kairon ton enestekota kath hon dora te kai thusiai prospherontai me dunamenai kata suneidesin teleiosai ton latreuonta
monon epi bromasin kai pomasin kai diaphorois baptismois kai dikaiomasin sarkos mechri kairou diorthoseos epikeimena
christos de paragenomenos archiereus ton mellonton agathon dia tes meizonos kai teleioteras skenes ou cheiropoietou tout estin ou tautes tes ktiseos
oude di haimatos tragon kai moschon dia de tou idiou haimatos eiselthen ephapax eis ta hagia aionian lutrosin heuramenos
ei gar to haima tauron kai tragon kai spodos damaleos hrantizousa tous kekoinomenous hagiazei pros ten tes sarkos katharoteta
poso mallon to haima tou christou hos dia pneumatos aioniou heauton prosenenken amomon to theo kathariei ten suneidesin humon apo nekron ergon eis to latreuein theo zonti
kai dia touto diathekes kaines mesites estin hopos thanatou genomenou eis apolutrosin ton epi te prote diatheke parabaseon ten epanelian labosin hoi keklemenoi tes aioniou kleronomias
hopou gar diatheke thanaton ananke pheresthai tou diathemenou
diatheke gar epi nekrois bebaia epei mepote ischuei hote ze ho diathemenos
hothen oud he prote choris haimatos enkekainistai
laletheises gar pases entoles kata nomon hupo mouseos panti to lao labon to haima ton moschon kai tragon meta hudatos kai eriou kokkinou kai hussopou auto te to biblion kai panta ton laon errantisen
legon touto to haima tes diathekes hes eneteilato pros humas ho theos
kai ten skenen de kai panta ta skeue tes leitourgias to haimati homoios errantisen
kai schedon en haimati panta katharizetai kata ton nomon kai choris haimatekchusias ou ginetai aphesis
ananke oun ta men hupodeigmata ton en tois ouranois toutois katharizesthai auta de ta epourania kreittosin thusiais para tautas
ou gar eis cheiropoieta hagia eiselthen ho christos antitupa ton alethinon all eis auton ton ouranon nun emphanisthenai to prosopo tou theou huper hemon
oud hina pollakis prosphere heauton hosper ho archiereus eiserchetai eis ta hagia kat eniauton en haimati allotrio
epei edei auton pollakis pathein apo kataboles kosmou nun de hapax epi sunteleia ton aionon eis athetesin hamartias dia tes thusias autou pephanerotai
kai kath hoson apokeitai tois anthropois hapax apothanein meta de touto krisis
houtos ho christos hapax prosenechtheis eis to pollon anenenkein hamartias ek deuterou choris hamartias ophthesetai tois auton apekdechomenois eis soterian
skian gar echon ho nomos ton mellonton agathon ouk auten ten eikona ton pragmaton kat eniauton tais autais thusiais has prospherousin eis to dienekes oudepote dunatai tous proserchomenous teleiosai
epei ouk an epausanto prospheromenai dia to medemian echein eti suneidesin hamartion tous latreuontas hapax kekatharmenous
all en autais anamnesis hamartion kat eniauton
adunaton gar haima tauron kai tragon aphairein hamartias
dio eiserchomenos eis ton kosmon legei thusian kai prosphoran ouk ethelesas soma de katertiso moi
holokautomata kai peri hamartias ouk eudokesas
tote eipon idou heko en kephalidi bibliou gegraptai peri emou tou poiesai ho theos to thelema sou
anoteron legon hoti thusian kai prosphoran kai holokautomata kai peri hamartias ouk ethelesas oude eudokesas haitines kata ton nomon prospherontai
tote eireken idou heko tou poiesai ho theos to thelema sou anairei to proton hina to deuteron stese
en ho thelemati hegiasmenoi esmen hoi dia tes prosphoras tou somatos tou iesou christou ephapax
kai pas men hiereus hesteken kath hemeran leitourgon kai tas autas pollakis prospheron thusias haitines oudepote dunantai perielein hamartias
autos de mian huper hamartion prosenenkas thusian eis to dienekes ekathisen en dexia tou theou
to loipon ekdechomenos heos tethosin hoi echthroi autou hupopodion ton podon autou
mia gar prosphora teteleioken eis to dienekes tous hagiazomenous
marturei de hemin kai to pneuma to hagion meta gar to proeirekenai
haute he diatheke hen diathesomai pros autous meta tas hemeras ekeinas legei kurios didous nomous mou epi kardias auton kai epi ton dianoion auton epigrapso autous
kai ton hamartion auton kai ton anomion auton ou me mnestho eti
hopou de aphesis touton ouketi prosphora peri hamartias
echontes oun adelphoi parresian eis ten eisodon ton hagion en to haimati iesou

ho heorakamen kai akekoamen apanellomen humin hina kai humeis koinonian echete meth hemon kai he koinonia de he hemetera meta tou patros kai meta tou huiou autou iesou christou
kai tauta graphomen humin hina he chara hemon e pepleromene
kai haute estin he epanelia hen akekoamen ap autou kai ananellomen humin hoti ho theos phos estin kai skotia en auto ouk estin oudemia
ean eipomen hoti koinonian echomen met autou kai en to skotei peripatomen pseudometha kai ou poioumen ten aletheian
ean de en to photi peripatomen hos autos estin en to photi koinonian echomen met allelon kai to haima iesou christou tou huiou autou katharizei hemas apo pases hamartias
ean eipomen hoti hamartian ouk echomen heautous planomen kai he aletheia ouk estin en hemin
ean homologomen tas hamartias hemon pistos estin kai dikaios hina aphe hemin tas hamartias kai katharise hemas apo pases adikias
ean eipomen hoti ouch hemartekamen pseusten poioumen auton kai ho logos autou ouk estin en hemin
teknia mou tauta grapho humin hina me hamartete kai ean tis hamarte parakleton echomen pros ton patera iesoun christon dikaion
kai autos hilasmos estin peri ton hamartion hemon ou peri ton hemeteron de monon alla kai peri holou tou kosmou
kai en touto ginoskomen hoti egnokamen auton ean tas entolas autou teromen
ho legon egnoka auton kai tas entolas autou me teron pseustes estin kai en touto he aletheia ouk estin
hos d an tere autou ton logon alethos en touto he agape tou theou teteleiotai en touto ginoskomen hoti en auto esmen
ho legon en auto menein opheilei kathos ekeinos periepatesen kai autos houtos peripatein
adelphoi ouk entolen kainen grapho humin all entolen palaian hen eichete ap arches he entole he palaia estin ho logos hon ekousate ap arches
palin entolen kainen grapho humin ho estin alethes en auto kai en humin hoti he skotia paragetai kai to phos to alethinon ede phainei
ho legon en to photi einai kai ton adelphon autou mison en te skotia estin heos arti
ho agapon ton adelphon autou en to photi menei kai skandalon en auto ouk estin
ho de mison ton adelphon autou en te skotia estin kai en te skotia peripatei kai ouk oiden pou hupagei hoti he skotia etuphlosen tous ophthalmous autou
grapho humin teknia hoti apheontai humin hai hamartiai dia to onoma autou
grapho humin pateres hoti egnokate ton ap arches grapho humin neaniskoi hoti nenikekate ton poneron grapho humin paidia hoti egnokate ton patera
egrapsa humin pateres hoti egnokate ton ap arches egrapsa humin neaniskoi hoti ischuroi este kai ho logos tou theou en humin menei kai nenikekate ton poneron
me agapate ton kosmon mede ta en to kosmo ean tis agapa ton kosmon ouk estin he agape tou patros en auto
hoti pan to en to kosmo he epithumia tes sarkos kai he epithumia ton ophthalmon kai he alazoneia tou biou ouk estin ek tou patros all ek tou kosmou estin
kai ho kosmos paragetai kai he epithumia autou ho de poion to thelema tou theou menei eis ton aiona
paidia eschate hora estin kai kathos ekousate hoti ho antichristos erchetai kai nun antichristoi polloi gegonasin hothen ginoskomen hoti eschate hora estin
ex hemon exelthon all ouk esan ex hemon ei gar esan ex hemon memenekeisan an meth hemon all hina phanerothosin hoti ouk eisin pantes ex hemon
kai humeis chrisma echete apo tou hagiou kai oidate panta
ouk egrapsa humin hoti ouk oidate ten aletheian all hoti oidate auten kai hoti pan pseudos ek tes aletheias ouk estin
tis estin ho pseustes ei me ho arnoumenos hoti iesous ouk estin ho christos houtos estin ho antichristos ho arnoumenos ton patera kai ton huion
pas ho arnoumenos ton huion oude ton patera echei
humeis oun ho ekousate ap arches en humin meneto ean en humin meine ho ap arches ekousate kai humeis en to huio kai en to patri meneite
kai haute estin he epanelia hen autos epeneilato hemin ten zoen ten aionion
tauta egrapsa humin peri ton planonton humas

kai humeis to chrisma ho elabete ap autou en humin menei kai ou chreian echete hina tis didaske humas all hos to auto chrisma didaskei humas peri panton kai alethes estin kai ouk estin pseudos kai kathos edidaxen humas meneite en auto
kai nun teknia menete en auto hina hotan phanerothe echomen parresian kai me aischunthomen ap autou en te parousia autou
ean eidete hoti dikaios estin ginoskete hoti pas ho poion ten dikaiosunen ex autou gegennetai
idete potapen agapen dedoken hemin ho pater hina tekna theou klethomen dia touto ho kosmos ou ginoskei hemas hoti ouk egno auton
agapetoi nun tekna theou esmen kai oupo ephanerothe ti esometha oidamen de hoti ean phanerothe homoioi auto esometha hoti opsometha auton kathos estin
kai pas ho echon ten elpida tauten ep auto hagnizei heauton kathos ekeinos hagnos estin
pas ho poion ten hamartian kai ten anomian poiei kai he hamartia estin he anomia
kai oidate hoti ekeinos ephanerothe hina tas hamartias hemon are kai hamartia en auto ouk estin
pas ho en auto menon ouch hamartanei pas ho hamartanon ouch heoraken auton oude egnoken auton
teknia medeis planato humas ho poion ten dikaiosunen dikaios estin kathos ekeinos dikaios estin
ho poion ten hamartian ek tou diabolou estin hoti ap arches ho diabolos hamartanei eis touto ephanerothe ho huios tou theou hina luse ta erga tou diabolou
pas ho gegennemenos ek tou theou hamartian ou poiei hoti sperma autou en auto menei kai ou dunatai hamartanein hoti ek tou theou gegennetai
en touto phanera estin ta tekna tou theou kai ta tekna tou diabolou pas ho me poion dikaiosunen ouk estin ek tou theou kai ho me agapon ton adelphon autou
hoti haute estin he anelia hen ekousate ap arches hina agapomen allelous
ou kathos kain ek tou ponerou en kai esphaxen ton adelphon autou kai charin tinos esphaxen auton hoti ta erga autou ponera en ta de tou adelphou autou dikaia
me thaumazete adelphoi mou ei misei humas ho kosmos
hemeis oidamen hoti metabebekamen ek tou thanatou eis ten zoen hoti agapomen tous adelphous ho me agapon ton adelphon menei en to thanato
pas ho mison ton adelphon autou anthropoktonos estin kai oidate hoti pas anthropoktonos ouk echei zoen aionion en auto menousan
en touto egnokamen ten agapen hoti ekeinos huper hemon ten psuchen autou etheken kai hemeis opheilomen huper ton adelphon tas psuchas tithenai
hos d an eche ton bion tou kosmou kai theore ton adelphon autou chreian echonta kai kleise ta splanchna autou ap autou pos he agape tou theou menei en auto
teknia mou me agapomen logo mede glosse all ergo kai aletheia
kai en touto ginoskomen hoti ek tes aletheias esmen kai emprosthen autou peisomen tas kardias hemon
hoti ean kataginoske hemon he kardia hoti meizon estin ho theos tes kardias hemon kai ginoskei panta
agapetoi ean he kardia hemon me kataginoske hemon parresian echomen pros ton theon
kai ho ean aitomen lambanomen par autou hoti tas entolas autou teroumen kai ta aresta enopion autou poioumen
kai haute estin he entole autou hina pisteusomen to onomati tou huiou autou iesou christou kai agapomen allelous kathos edoken entolen hemin
kai ho teron tas entolas autou en auto menei kai autos en auto kai en touto ginoskomen hoti menei en hemin ek tou pneumatos hou hemin edoken
agapetoi me panti pneumati pisteuete alla dokimazete ta pneumata ei ek tou theou estin hoti polloi pseudoprophetai exeleluthasin eis ton kosmon
en touto ginoskete to pneuma tou theou pan pneuma ho homologei iesoun christon en sarki eleluthota ek tou theou estin
kai pan pneuma ho me homologei ton iesoun christon en sarki eleluthota ek tou theou ouk estin kai touto estin to tou antichristou ho akekoate hoti erchetai kai nun en to kosmo estin ede
humeis ek tou theou este teknia kai nenikekate autous hoti meizon estin ho en humin e ho en to kosmo
autoi ek tou kosmou eisin dia touto ek tou kosmou lalousin kai ho kosmos auton akouei
hemeis ek tou theou esmen ho ginoskon ton theon akouei hemon hos ouk estin ek tou theou ouk akouei hemon ek toutou ginoskomen to pneuma tes aletheias kai to pneuma tes planes
agapetoi agapomen allelous hoti he agape ek tou theou estin kai pas ho agapon ek tou theou gegennetai kai ginoskei ton theon
ho me agapon ouk egno ton theon hoti ho theos agape estin
en touto ephanerothe he agape tou theou en hemin hoti ton huion autou ton monogene apestalken ho theos eis ton kosmon hina zesomen di autou
en touto estin he agape ouch hoti hemeis egapesamen ton theon all hoti autos egapesen hemas kai apesteilen ton huion autou hilasmon peri ton hamartion hemon
agapetoi ei houtos ho theos egapesen hemas kai hemeis opheilomen allelous agapan
theon oudeis popote tetheatai ean agapomen allelous ho theos en hemin menei kai he agape autou teteleiomene estin en hemin
en touto ginoskomen hoti en auto menomen kai autos en hemin hoti ek tou pneumatos autou dedoken hemin
kai hemeis tetheametha kai marturoumen hoti ho pater apestalken ton huion sotera tou kosmou
hos an homologese hoti iesous estin ho huios tou theou ho theos en auto menei kai autos en to theo
kai hemeis egnokamen kai pepisteukamen ten agapen hen echei ho theos en hemin ho theos agape estin kai ho menon en te agape en to theo menei kai ho theos en auto
en touto teteleiotai he agape meth hemon hina parresian echomen en te hemera tes kriseos hoti kathos ekeinos estin kai hemeis esmen en to kosmo touto
phobos ouk estin en te agape all he teleia agape exo ballei ton phobon hoti ho phobos kolasin echei ho de phoboumenos ou teteleiotai en te agape
hemeis agapomen auton hoti autos protos egapesen hemas
ean tis eipe hoti agapo ton theon kai ton adelphon autou mise pseustes estin ho gar me agapon ton adelphon autou hon heoraken ton theon hon ouch heoraken pos dunatai agapan
kai tauten ten entolen echomen ap autou hina ho agapon ton theon agapa kai ton adelphon autou
pas ho pisteuon hoti iesous estin ho christos ek tou theou gegennetai kai pas ho agapon ton gennesanta agapa kai ton gegennemenon ex autou
en touto ginoskomen hoti agapomen ta tekna tou theou hotan ton theon agapomen kai tas entolas autou teromen
haute gar estin he agape tou theou hina tas entolas autou teromen kai hai entolai autou bareiai ouk eisin
hoti pan to gegennemenon ek tou theou nika ton kosmon kai haute estin he nike he nikesasa ton kosmon he pistis hemon
tis estin ho nikon ton kosmon ei me ho pisteuon hoti iesous estin ho huios tou theou
houtos estin ho elthon di hudatos kai haimatos iesous ho christos ouk en to hudati monon all en to hudati kai to haimati kai to pneuma estin to marturoun hoti to pneuma estin he aletheia
hoti treis eisin hoi marturountes hen to ourano ho pater ho logos kai to hagion pneuma kai houtoi hoi treis hen eisin
kai treis eisin hoi marturountes hen te ge to pneuma kai to hudor kai to haima kai hoi treis eis to hen eisin
ei ten marturian ton anthropon lambanomen he marturia tou theou meizon estin hoti haute estin he marturia tou theou hen memartureken peri tou huiou autou
ho pisteuon eis ton huion tou theou echei ten marturian en heauto ho me pisteuon to theo pseusten pepoieken auton hoti ou pepisteuken eis ten marturian hen memartureken ho theos peri tou huiou autou
kai haute estin he marturia hoti zoen aionion edoken hemin ho theos kai haute he zoe en to huio autou estin
ho echon ton huion echei ten zoen ho me echon ton huion tou theou ten zoen ouk echei
tauta egrapsa humin tois pisteuousin eis to onoma tou huiou tou theou hina eidete hoti zoen echete aionion kai hina pisteuete eis to onoma tou huiou tou theou
kai haute estin he parresia hen echomen pros auton hoti ean ti aitometha kata to thelema autou akouei hemon
kai ean oidamen hoti akouei hemon ho an aitometha oidamen hoti echomen ta aitemata ha etekamen par autou
ean tis ide ton adelphon autou hamartanonta hamartian me pros thanaton aitesei kai dosei auto zoen tois hamartanousin me pros thanaton estin hamartia pros thanaton ou peri ekeines lego hina erotese
pasa adikia hamartia estin kai estin hamartia ou pros thanaton
oidamen hoti pas ho gegennemenos ek tou theou ouch hamartanei all ho gennetheis ek tou theou terei heauton kai ho poneros ouch haptetai autou
oidamen hoti ek tou theou esmen kai ho kosmos holos en to ponero keitai

oidamen de hoti ho huios tou theou hekei kai dedoken hemin dianoian hina ginoskomen ton alethinon kai esmen en to alethino en to huio autou iesou christo houtos estin ho alethinos theos kai he zoe aionios
teknia phulaxate heautous apo ton eidolon amen
2 John: ho presbuteros eklekte kuria kai tois teknois autes hous ego agapo en aletheia kai ouk ego monos alla kai pantes hoi egnokotes ten aletheian
dia ten aletheian ten menousan en hemin kai meth hemon estai eis ton aiona
estai meth hemon charis eleos eirene para theou patros kai para kuriou iesou christou tou huiou tou patros en aletheia kai agape
echaren lian hoti heureka ek ton teknon sou peripatountas en aletheia kathos entolen elabomen para tou patros
kai nun eroto se kuria ouch hos entolen grapho soi kainen alla hen eichomen ap arches hina agapomen allelous
kai haute estin he agape hina peripatomen kata tas entolas autou haute estin he entole kathos ekousate ap arches hina en aute peripatete
hoti polloi planoi eiselthon eis ton kosmon hoi me homologountes iesoun christon erchomenon en sarki houtos estin ho planos kai ho antichristos
blepete heautous hina me apolesomen ha eirgasametha alla misthon plere apolabomen
pas ho parabainon kai me menon en te didache tou christou theon ouk echei ho menon en te didache tou christou houtos kai ton patera kai ton huion echei
ei tis erchetai pros humas kai tauten ten didachen ou pherei me lambanete auton eis oikian kai chairein auto me legete
ho gar legon auto chairein koinonei tois ergois autou tois ponerois
polla echon humin graphein ouk eboulethen dia chartou kai melanos alla elpizo elthein pros humas kai stoma pros stoma lalesai hina he chara hemon e pepleromene
aspazetai se ta tekna tes adelphes sou tes eklektes amen
3 John: ho presbuteros gaio to agapeto hon ego agapo en aletheia
agapete peri panton euchomai se euodousthai kai hugiainein kathos euodoutai sou he psuche
echaren gar lian erchomenon adelphon kai marturounton sou te aletheia kathos su en aletheia peripateis
meizoteran touton ouk echo charan hina akouo ta ema tekna en aletheia peripatounta
agapete piston poieis ho ean ergase eis tous adelphous kai eis tous xenous
hoi emarturesan sou te agape enopion ekklesias hous kalos poieseis propempsas axios tou theou
huper gar tou onomatos exelthon meden lambanontes apo ton ethnon
hemeis oun opheilomen apolambanein tous toioutous hina sunergoi ginometha te aletheia
egrapsa te ekklesia all ho philoproteuon auton diotrephes ouk epidechetai hemas

dia touto ean eltho hupomneso autou ta erga ha poiei logois ponerois phluaron hemas kai me arkoumenos epi toutois oute autos epidechetai tous adelphous kai tous boulomenous koluei kai ek tes ekklesias ekballei
agapete me mimou to kakon alla to agathon ho agathopoion ek tou theou estin ho de kakopoion ouch heoraken ton theon
demetrio memarturetai hupo panton kai hup autes tes aletheias kai hemeis de marturoumen kai oidate hoti he marturia hemon alethes estin
polla eichon graphein all ou thelo dia melanos kai kalamou soi grapsai
elpizo de eutheos idein se kai stoma pros stoma lalesomen eirene soi aspazontai se hoi philoi aspazou tous philous kat onoma
Jude: ioudas iesou christou doulos adelphos de iakobou tois en theo patri hegiasmenois kai iesou christo teteremenois kletois
eleos humin kai eirene kai agape plethuntheie
agapetoi pasan spouden poioumenos graphein humin peri tes koines soterias ananken eschon grapsai humin parakalon epagonizesthai te hapax paradotheise tois hagiois pistei

pareisedusan gar tines anthropoi hoi palai progegrammenoi eis touto to krima asebeis ten tou theou hemon charin metatithentes eis aselgeian kai ton monon despoten theon kai kurion hemon iesoun christon arnoumenoi
hupomnesai de humas boulomai eidotas humas hapax touto hoti ho kurios laon ek ges aiguptou sosas to deuteron tous me pisteusantas apolesen
anelous te tous me teresantas ten heauton archen alla apolipontas to idion oiketerion eis krisin megales hemeras desmois aidiois hupo zophon tetereken
hos sodoma kai gomorra kai hai peri autas poleis ton homoion toutois tropon ekporneusasai kai apelthousai opiso sarkos heteras prokeintai deigma puros aioniou diken hupechousai
homoios mentoi kai houtoi enupniazomenoi sarka men miainousin kurioteta de athetousin doxas de blasphemousin
ho de michael ho archanelos hote to diabolo diakrinomenos dielegeto peri tou moseos somatos ouk etolmesen krisin epenenkein blasphemias all eipen epitimesai soi kurios
houtoi de hosa men ouk oidasin blasphemousin hosa de phusikos hos ta aloga zoa epistantai en toutois phtheirontai
ouai autois hoti te hodo tou kain eporeuthesan kai te plane tou balaam misthou exechuthesan kai te antilogia tou kore apolonto
houtoi eisin en tais agapais humon spilades suneuochoumenoi aphobos heautous poimainontes nephelai anudroi hupo anemon peripheromenai dendra phthinoporina akarpa dis apothanonta ekrizothenta
kumata agria thalasses epaphrizonta tas heauton aischunas asteres planetai hois ho zophos tou skotous eis ton aiona teteretai
proepheteusen de kai toutois hebdomos apo adam henoch legon idou elthen kurios en muriasin hagiais autou
poiesai krisin kata panton kai exelegxai pantas tous asebeis auton peri panton ton ergon asebeias auton hon esebesan kai peri panton ton skleron hon elalesan kat autou hamartoloi asebeis
houtoi eisin gonustai mempsimoiroi kata tas epithumias auton poreuomenoi kai to stoma auton lalei huperonka thaumazontes prosopa opheleias charin
humeis de agapetoi mnesthete ton hrematon ton proeiremenon hupo ton apostolon tou kuriou hemon iesou christou
hoti elegon humin hoti en eschato chrono esontai empaiktai kata tas heauton epithumias poreuomenoi ton asebeion
houtoi eisin hoi apodiorizontes psuchikoi pneuma me echontes
humeis de agapetoi te hagiotate humon pistei epoikodomountes heautous en pneumati hagio proseuchomenoi
heautous en agape theou teresate prosdechomenoi to eleos tou kuriou hemon iesou christou eis zoen aionion
kai hous men eleeite diakrinomenoi
hous de en phobo sozete ek tou puros harpazontes misountes kai ton apo tes sarkos espilomenon chitona
to de dunameno phulaxai autous aptaistous kai stesai katenopion tes doxes autou amomous en agalliasei
mono sopho theo soteri hemon doxa kai megalosune kratos kai exousia kai nun kai eis pantas tous aionas amen
Revelation: apokalupsis iesou christou hen edoken auto ho theos deixai tois doulois autou ha dei genesthai en tachei kai esemanen aposteilas dia tou anelou autou to doulo autou ioanne
hos emarturesen ton logon tou theou kai ten marturian iesou christou hosa te eiden
makarios ho anaginoskon kai hoi akouontes tous logous tes propheteias kai terountes ta en aute gegrammena ho gar kairos enus
ioannes tais hepta ekklesiais tais en te asia charis humin kai eirene apo tou ho on kai ho en kai ho erchomenos kai apo ton hepta pneumaton ha estin enopion tou thronou autou
kai apo iesou christou ho martus ho pistos ho prototokos ek ton nekron kai ho archon ton basileon tes ges to agapesanti hemas kai lousanti hemas apo ton hamartion hemon en to haimati autou
kai epoiesen hemas basileis kai hiereis to theo kai patri autou auto he doxa kai to kratos eis tous aionas ton aionon amen
idou erchetai meta ton nephelon kai opsetai auton pas ophthalmos kai hoitines auton exekentesan kai kopsontai ep auton pasai hai phulai tes ges nai amen
ego eimi to a kai to o arche kai telos legei ho kurios ho on kai ho en kai ho erchomenos ho pantokrator

ego ioannes ho kai adelphos humon kai sunkoinonos en te thlipsei kai en te basileia kai hupomone iesou christou egenomen en te neso te kaloumene patmo dia ton logon tou theou kai dia ten marturian iesou christou
egenomen en pneumati en te kuriake hemera kai ekousa opiso mou phonen megalen hos salpinos

legouses ego eimi to a kai to o ho protos kai ho eschatos kai ho blepeis grapson eis biblion kai pempson tais ekklesiais tais en asia eis epheson kai eis smurnan kai eis pergamon kai eis thuateira kai eis sardeis kai eis philadelpheian kai eis laodikeian
kai epestrepsa blepein ten phonen hetis elalesen met emou kai epistrepsas eidon hepta luchnias chrusas
kai en meso ton hepta luchnion homoion huio anthropou endedumenon podere kai periezosmenon pros tois mastois zonen chrusen
he de kephale autou kai hai triches leukai hosei erion leukon hos chion kai hoi ophthalmoi autou hos phlox puros
kai hoi podes autou homoioi chalkolibano hos en kamino pepuromenoi kai he phone autou hos phone hudaton pollon
kai echon en te dexia autou cheiri asteras hepta kai ek tou stomatos autou hromphaia distomos oxeia ekporeuomene kai he opsis autou hos ho helios phainei en te dunamei autou
kai hote eidon auton epesa pros tous podas autou hos nekros kai epetheken ten dexian autou cheira ep eme legon moi me phobou ego eimi ho protos kai ho eschatos
kai ho zon kai egenomen nekros kai idou zon eimi eis tous aionas ton aionon amen kai echo tas kleis tou hadou kai tou thanatou
grapson ha eides kai ha eisin kai ha mellei ginesthai meta tauta

to musterion ton hepta asteron hon eides epi tes dexias mou kai tas hepta luchnias tas chrusas hoi hepta asteres aneloi ton hepta ekklesion eisin kai hai hepta luchniai has eides hepta ekklesiai eisin
to anelo tes ephesines ekklesias grapson tade legei ho kraton tous hepta asteras en te dexia autou ho peripaton en meso ton hepta luchnion ton chruson
oida ta erga sou kai ton kopon sou kai ten hupomonen sou kai hoti ou dune bastasai kakous kai epeiraso tous phaskontas einai apostolous kai ouk eisin kai heures autous pseudeis
kai ebastasas kai hupomonen echeis kai dia to onoma mou kekopiakas kai ou kekmekas
all echo kata sou hoti ten agapen sou ten proten aphekas

kai edothe moi kalamos homoios hrabdo legon egeirai kai metreson ton naon tou theou kai to thusiasterion kai tous proskunountas en auto
kai ten aulen ten esothen tou naou ekbale exo kai me auten metreses hoti edothe tois ethnesin kai ten polin ten hagian patesousin menas tessarakonta duo
